translations.literal: Together with the various Confucian officials he revised the Comprehensive Treatises; Gui Chongjing was in charge of the Treatise on Ritual, and all praised it as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Together with the various Confucian officials he revised the Comprehensive Treatises; Gui Chongjing was in charge of the Treatise on Ritual, which all praised as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 時皇太子欲以仲秋之月，於國學行齒胄之禮。

translations.literal: At that time the Crown Prince wished to perform the capping-and-enfeoffment rite at the Directorate of Education in the mid-autumn month.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Crown Prince wished to perform the capping-and-enfeoffment rite at the Directorate of Education in mid-autumn.

sentences.zh: 崇敬以國學及官名不稱，請改國學之制，兼更其名，曰：

translations.literal: Gui Chongjing held that the directorate and its official titles were improperly named, and requested reform of the directorate's institutions and a change of its name, arguing,
translations.idiomatic: Gui Chongjing held that the directorate and its official titles were improperly named, and requested reform of its institutions and a change of name, arguing,

sentences.zh: 《禮記·王制》曰，天子學曰「辟雍」。

translations.literal: The "Royal Regulations" chapter of the Book of Rites says the Son of Heaven's academy is called "Piyong."
translations.idiomatic: The "Royal Regulations" chapter of the Book of Rites says the Son of Heaven's academy is called "Piyong."

sentences.zh: 又《五經通義》云：「辟雍，養老教學之所也。」

translations.literal: The Exegesis of the Five Classics also says: "Piyong is the place where the aged are cared for and teaching is carried out."
translations.idiomatic: The Exegesis of the Five Classics also says: "Piyong is the place where the aged are cared for and teaching is carried out."

sentences.zh: 以形制言之，雍，壅也；

translations.literal: Speaking of its form, yong means "to dam";
translations.idiomatic: In terms of form, yong means "to dam";

sentences.zh: 辟，璧也，壅水環之，圓如璧形。

translations.literal: pi means "jade disk"—water is dammed around it, round as a disk.
translations.idiomatic: pi means "jade disk"—water is dammed around it, round as a disk.

sentences.zh: 以義理言之，辟，明也；

translations.literal: Speaking of its meaning, pi means "to illumine";
translations.idiomatic: In terms of meaning, pi means "to illumine";

sentences.zh: 雍，和也，言以禮樂明和天下。

translations.literal: yong means "harmony"—that is, to harmonize the realm through ritual and music.
translations.idiomatic: yong means "harmony"—that is, to harmonize the realm through ritual and music.

sentences.zh: 《禮記》亦謂之澤宮。

translations.literal: The Book of Rites also calls it the Marsh Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Rites also calls it the Marsh Palace.

sentences.zh: 《射義》云：天子將祭，必先習射於澤宮。

translations.literal: The Archery Rites says: before the Son of Heaven sacrifices, he must first practice archery at the Marsh Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Archery Rites says: before the Son of Heaven sacrifices, he must first practice archery at the Marsh Palace.

sentences.zh: 故前代文士，亦呼雲璧池，亦曰璧沼，亦謂之學省。

translations.literal: Therefore scholars of former ages also called it the Cloud Disk Pool, also the Disk Marsh, and also the Academy Office.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore scholars of former ages also called it the Cloud Disk Pool, the Disk Marsh, and the Academy Office.

sentences.zh: 後漢光武立明堂、辟雍、靈臺，謂之三雍宮。

translations.literal: Emperor Guangwu of Later Han built the Bright Hall, Piyong, and Spirit Terrace—the Three Yong Palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Guangwu of Later Han built the Bright Hall, Piyong, and Spirit Terrace—the Three Yong Palaces.

sentences.zh: 至明帝，躬行養老於其中。

translations.literal: By the time of Emperor Ming he personally performed the rite of caring for the aged there.
translations.idiomatic: By the time of Emperor Ming he personally performed the rite of caring for the aged there.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝亦作明堂、辟雍、靈臺，親臨辟雍，行鄉飲酒之禮。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Jin also built the Bright Hall, Piyong, and Spirit Terrace, personally attended Piyong, and performed the district drinking rite.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Jin also built the Bright Hall, Piyong, and Spirit Terrace, personally attended Piyong, and performed the district drinking rite.

sentences.zh: 又別立國子學，以殊士庶。

translations.literal: He also separately established the Directorate of the Sons of the State to distinguish them from commoners.
translations.idiomatic: He also separately established the Directorate of the Sons of the State to distinguish them from commoners.

sentences.zh: 永嘉南遷，唯有國子學，不立辟雍。

translations.literal: When the court moved south at Yongjia, only the Directorate of the Sons of the State remained; Piyong was not built.
translations.idiomatic: When the court moved south at Yongjia, only the Directorate of the Sons of the State remained; Piyong was not built.

sentences.zh: 北齊立國子寺，隋初亦然。

translations.literal: Northern Qi established the Directorate of the Sons of the State as a temple; the early Sui did likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Qi established the Directorate of the Sons of the State as a temple; early Sui did likewise.

sentences.zh: 至煬帝大業十三年，改為國子監。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Daye of Emperor Yang it was changed to the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Daye under Emperor Yang it was changed to the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 今國家富有四海，聲明文物之盛，唯辟雍獨闕，伏請改國子監為辟雍省。

translations.literal: Now the state possesses all within the four seas, and in the splendor of culture and ritual only Piyong is lacking—I humbly request that the Directorate of Education be renamed the Piyong Office.
translations.idiomatic: Now the state possesses all within the four seas, and in the splendor of culture and ritual only Piyong is lacking—I humbly ask that the Directorate of Education be renamed the Piyong Office.

sentences.zh: 又以：

translations.literal: He also argued,
translations.idiomatic: He also argued,

sentences.zh: 祭酒之名，非學官所宜。

translations.literal: The title Director of Sacrifices is unsuitable for an academic official.
translations.idiomatic: The title Director of Sacrifices is unsuitable for an academic official.

sentences.zh: 按《周禮》：「師氏掌以義詔王，教國子。」

translations.literal: According to the Rites of Zhou: "The Director of Masters is charged to instruct the king in righteousness and to teach the sons of the state."
translations.idiomatic: According to the Rites of Zhou: "The Director of Masters is charged to instruct the king in righteousness and to teach the sons of the state."

sentences.zh: 請改祭酒為太師氏，位正三品。

translations.literal: I request that Director of Sacrifices be changed to Grand Director of Masters, with rank of regular third grade.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Director of Sacrifices be changed to Grand Director of Masters, with rank of regular third grade.

sentences.zh: 又司業者，義在《禮記》，雲「樂正司業」。

translations.literal: As for Vice Director, the meaning is in the Book of Rites, which says "Music Master Vice Director."
translations.idiomatic: As for Vice Director, the meaning appears in the Book of Rites, which speaks of the "Music Master Vice Director."

sentences.zh: 正，長也，言樂官之長，司主此業。

translations.literal: Zheng means "chief"—that is, the chief of the music officials who presides over this work.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng means "chief"—the chief of the music officials who presides over this work.

sentences.zh: 《爾雅》云：「大板謂之業。」

translations.literal: The Erya says: "A large board is called ye."
translations.idiomatic: The Erya says: "A large board is called ye."

sentences.zh: 按《詩·周頌》：「設業設虡，崇牙樹羽。」

translations.literal: According to the Zhou Odes of the Book of Poetry: "They set up the ye and the ju, with high teeth and planted feathers."
translations.idiomatic: According to the Zhou Odes of the Book of Poetry: "They set up the ye and the ju, with high teeth and planted feathers."

sentences.zh: 則業是懸鐘磬之栒虡也。

translations.literal: Thus ye is the crossbeam from which bells and chime-stones are suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ye is the crossbeam from which bells and chime-stones are suspended.

sentences.zh: 今太學既不教樂，於義則無所取，請改司業一為左師，一為右師，位正四品。

translations.literal: Now the Grand Academy no longer teaches music, so in meaning there is nothing to take from this—I request that the two Vice Director posts be changed to Left Master and Right Master, with rank of regular fourth grade.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Grand Academy no longer teaches music, the title has no real meaning—I ask that the two Vice Director posts be changed to Left Master and Right Master, with rank of regular fourth grade.

sentences.zh: 又以：

translations.literal: He also argued,
translations.idiomatic: He also argued,

sentences.zh: 《五經》六籍，古先哲王致理之式也。

translations.literal: The Five Classics and Six Books are the models by which the ancient sage-kings brought order.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Classics and Six Books are the models by which the ancient sage-kings brought order.

sentences.zh: 國家創業，制取賢之法，立明經，發微言於眾學，釋回增美，選賢與能。

translations.literal: When the state was founded it established methods for selecting the worthy, instituted the Mingjing examination, drew subtle meaning from the many schools, refined the base and increased the fine, and selected the worthy and able.
translations.idiomatic: When the state was founded it established methods for selecting the worthy, instituted the Mingjing examination, drew subtle meaning from the many schools, refined the coarse and elevated the fine, and selected the worthy and able.

sentences.zh: 自艱難已來，取人頗易，考試不求其文義，及第先取於帖經，遂使專門業廢，請益無從，師資禮虧，傳受義絕。

translations.literal: Since the times of hardship, selection has become too easy; examinations do not seek textual meaning, and passing depends first on reciting passages by heart—thus specialized study has collapsed, there is no one from whom to seek instruction, the teacher's ritual is impaired, and the transmission of meaning is broken.
translations.idiomatic: Since the times of hardship, selection has become too easy; examinations no longer test textual meaning, and passing depends first on reciting passages by heart—thus specialized study has collapsed, instruction has withered, the teacher's ritual is impaired, and the transmission of meaning is broken.

sentences.zh: 今請以《禮記》、《左傳》為大經；

translations.literal: Now I request that the Book of Rites and the Zuo Commentary be made major classics;
translations.idiomatic: Now I ask that the Book of Rites and the Zuo Commentary be made major classics;

sentences.zh: 《周禮》、《儀禮》、《毛詩》為中經；

translations.literal: the Rites of Zhou, Ceremonial Rites, and Mao Odes be made middle classics;
translations.idiomatic: the Rites of Zhou, Ceremonial Rites, and Mao Odes be made middle classics;

sentences.zh: 《尚書》、《周易》為小經，各置博士一員。

translations.literal: the Book of Documents and Book of Changes be made minor classics, with one erudite appointed for each.
translations.idiomatic: the Book of Documents and Book of Changes be made minor classics, with one erudite appointed for each.

sentences.zh: 其《公羊》、《穀梁》文疏少，請共準一中經，通置博士一員。

translations.literal: The Gongyang and Guliang commentaries have sparse exegeses—I ask that together they be treated as one middle classic, with one erudite appointed for both.
translations.idiomatic: The Gongyang and Guliang commentaries have sparse exegeses—I ask that together they be treated as one middle classic, with one erudite appointed for both.

sentences.zh: 所擇博士，兼通《孝經》、《論語》，依憑章疏，講解分明，註引旁通，問十得九；

translations.literal: The erudites chosen should also be thoroughly versed in the Classic of Filial Piety and Analects, able to explain clearly according to chapter and commentary, cite broadly in answer, and answer nine of ten questions correctly;
translations.idiomatic: The erudites chosen should also be thoroughly versed in the Classic of Filial Piety and Analects, able to explain clearly according to chapter and commentary, cite broadly in answer, and answer nine of ten questions correctly;

sentences.zh: 兼德行純潔，文詞雅正，儀形規範，可為師表者。

translations.literal: and also pure in conduct, elegant in literary expression, and correct in bearing—fit to serve as models for teachers.
translations.idiomatic: and also pure in conduct, elegant in literary expression, and correct in bearing—fit to serve as models for teachers.

sentences.zh: 令四品以上各舉所知。

translations.literal: Let all of fourth rank and above each recommend those they know.
translations.idiomatic: Let all officials of fourth rank and above each recommend those they know.

sentences.zh: 在外者給驛，年七十已上者蒲輪。

translations.literal: Those from outside the capital should be given post horses; those seventy years of age and above should receive rush-wheeled carts.
translations.idiomatic: Those from outside the capital should be given post horses; those seventy years of age and above should receive rush-wheeled carts.

sentences.zh: 其國子、太學、四門、三館，各立五經博士，品秩上下，生徒之數，各有差。

translations.literal: The Directorate of the Sons of the State, Grand Academy, Four Gates, and Three Halls should each establish erudites of the Five Classics, with ranks and numbers of students varying by grade.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of the Sons of the State, Grand Academy, Four Gates, and Three Halls should each establish erudites of the Five Classics, with ranks and numbers of students varying by grade.

sentences.zh: 其舊博士、助教、直講、經直及律館、算館助教，請皆罷省。

translations.literal: The old erudites, assistant instructors, lecturers, scripture directors, and the assistant instructors of the Law Hall and Arithmetic Hall—I ask that all be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The old erudites, assistant instructors, lecturers, scripture directors, and the assistant instructors of the Law Hall and Arithmetic Hall—I ask that all be abolished.

sentences.zh: 其教授之法，學生至監，謁同業師。

translations.literal: As for the method of instruction: when a student arrives at the directorate, he calls on the master of his specialty.
translations.idiomatic: As for the method of instruction: when a student arrives at the directorate, he calls on the master of his specialty.

sentences.zh: 其所執贄，脯脩一束、清酒一壺，衫布一段，其色隨師所服。

translations.literal: The gifts he presents are one bundle of dried meat, one jar of clear wine, and one length of shirt cloth, the color matching the master's dress.
translations.idiomatic: The gifts he presents are one bundle of dried meat, one jar of clear wine, and one length of shirt cloth, the color matching the master's dress.

sentences.zh: 師出中門，延入與坐，割脩斟酒，三爵而止。

translations.literal: When the master goes out the middle gate, the student is invited in to sit; meat is cut, wine poured, and three cups offered before stopping.
translations.idiomatic: When the master goes out the middle gate, the student is invited in to sit; meat is cut, wine poured, and three cups offered before stopping.

sentences.zh: 乃發篋出經，摳衣前請。

translations.literal: Then the chest is opened and the classic brought out; the student gathers his robe and steps forward to request instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Then the chest is opened and the classic brought out; the student gathers his robe and steps forward to request instruction.

sentences.zh: 師為依經辨理，略舉一隅，然後就室。

translations.literal: The master explains according to the text, briefly opening one corner of meaning, and then the student withdraws to his room.
translations.idiomatic: The master explains according to the text, briefly opening one corner of meaning, and then the student withdraws to his room.

sentences.zh: 每朝、晡二時請益，師亦二時居講堂，說釋道義，發明大體，兼教以文行忠信之道，示以孝悌睦友之義。

translations.literal: Morning and afternoon he twice requests further instruction; the master also twice sits in the lecture hall, explaining meaning, clarifying the great principles, and also teaching the Way of culture, conduct, loyalty, and faith, showing the meaning of filial piety, brotherhood, harmony, and friendship.
translations.idiomatic: Morning and afternoon he twice requests further instruction; the master also twice sits in the lecture hall, explaining meaning, clarifying the great principles, and teaching the Way of culture, conduct, loyalty, and faith, showing the meaning of filial piety, brotherhood, harmony, and friendship.

sentences.zh: 旬省月試，時考歲貢。

translations.literal: Each ten-day period is reviewed, each month tested, and each year tribute is assessed.
translations.idiomatic: Each ten-day period is reviewed, each month tested, and each year tribute is assessed.

sentences.zh: 以生徒及第多少，為博士考課上下。

translations.literal: The number of students who pass determines whether an erudite's performance review is rated high or low.
translations.idiomatic: The number of students who pass determines whether an erudite's performance review is rated high or low.

sentences.zh: 其有不率教，者，則槚楚撲之。

translations.literal: Those who do not follow instruction are beaten with rods and paddled.
translations.idiomatic: Those who do not follow instruction are beaten with rods and paddled.

sentences.zh: 國子不率教者，則申禮部，移為太學。

translations.literal: Those in the Directorate of the Sons of the State who do not follow instruction are reported to the Ministry of Rites and transferred to the Grand Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Those in the Directorate of the Sons of the State who do not follow instruction are reported to the Ministry of Rites and transferred to the Grand Academy.

sentences.zh: 太學之不變者，移之四門。

translations.literal: Those in the Grand Academy who do not reform are transferred to the Four Gates.
translations.idiomatic: Those in the Grand Academy who do not reform are transferred to the Four Gates.

sentences.zh: 四門之不變者，歸本州之學。

translations.literal: Those in the Four Gates who do not reform are returned to their home prefecture's school.
translations.idiomatic: Those in the Four Gates who do not reform are returned to their home prefecture's school.

sentences.zh: 州學之不變者，復本役，終身不齒。

translations.literal: Those in the prefecture school who do not reform are returned to corvée duty and for life are not ranked among peers.
translations.idiomatic: Those in the prefecture school who do not reform are returned to corvée duty and for life are not ranked among peers.

sentences.zh: 雖率教九年而學不成者，亦歸之州學。

translations.literal: Even if they follow instruction for nine years yet fail to complete their studies, they too are returned to the prefecture school.
translations.idiomatic: Even if they follow instruction for nine years yet fail to complete their studies, they too are returned to the prefecture school.

sentences.zh: 其禮部考試之法，請無帖經，但於所習經中問大義二十，得十八為通；

translations.literal: As for the Ministry of Rites examination method, I request that recitation by heart be abolished; instead, from the classic studied one should be asked twenty questions on great meaning, and answering eighteen correctly counts as passing;
translations.idiomatic: As for the Ministry of Rites examination method, I ask that recitation by heart be abolished; instead, from the classic studied one should be asked twenty questions on great meaning, and answering eighteen correctly counts as passing;

sentences.zh: 兼《論語》、《孝經》各問十得八，兼讀所問文註義疏，必令通熟者為一通。

translations.literal: on the Analects and Classic of Filial Piety ten questions each with eight correct answers, and one must also read aloud the text, commentary, and exegesis asked about and be thoroughly fluent—this counts as one pass.
translations.idiomatic: on the Analects and Classic of Filial Piety ten questions each with eight correct answers, and one must also read aloud the text, commentary, and exegesis asked about and be thoroughly fluent—this counts as one pass.

sentences.zh: 又於本經問時務策三道，通二為及第。

translations.literal: Also ask three policy questions on current affairs from the classic studied; answering two correctly counts as passing.
translations.idiomatic: Also ask three policy questions on current affairs from the classic studied; answering two correctly counts as passing.

sentences.zh: 其中有孝行聞於鄉閭者，舉解具言於習業之下。

translations.literal: If any have filial conduct renowned in their village, let the recommendation fully state this beneath the record of their study.
translations.idiomatic: If any have filial conduct renowned in their village, let the recommendation fully state this beneath the record of their study.

sentences.zh: 省試之日，觀其所實，義少兩道，亦請兼收。

translations.literal: On the day of the provincial examination, observe the facts; if they fall short by two policy answers, I still ask that they be admitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of the provincial examination, observe the facts; if they fall short by two policy answers, I still ask that they be admitted.

sentences.zh: 其天下鄉貢，亦如之。

translations.literal: Provincial tribute throughout the realm should follow the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial tribute throughout the realm should follow the same rule.

sentences.zh: 習業考試，並以明經為名。

translations.literal: Study and examination should both be called Mingjing.
translations.idiomatic: Study and examination should both be called Mingjing.

sentences.zh: 得第者，授官之資與進士同。

translations.literal: Those who pass should receive appointment qualifications equal to jinshi graduates.
translations.idiomatic: Those who pass should receive appointment qualifications equal to jinshi graduates.

sentences.zh: 若此，則教義日深，而禮讓興；

translations.literal: If this is done, then teaching and meaning will deepen daily, and ritual and deference will rise;
translations.idiomatic: If this is done, teaching and meaning will deepen daily, and ritual and deference will rise;

sentences.zh: 禮讓興，則強不犯弱，眾不暴寡。

translations.literal: when ritual and deference rise, the strong will not violate the weak, and the many will not oppress the few.
translations.idiomatic: when ritual and deference rise, the strong will not violate the weak, and the many will not oppress the few.

sentences.zh: 此由太學而來者也。

translations.literal: This is what comes from the Grand Academy.
translations.idiomatic: This is what comes from the Grand Academy.

sentences.zh: 詔下尚書集百僚定議以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to gather the hundred officials, fix deliberation, and report.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to gather the hundred officials, settle deliberation, and report.

sentences.zh: 議者以為省者，禁也，非外司所宜名。

translations.literal: Those in debate held that "office" means "prohibition," and is not a name outer departments should use.
translations.idiomatic: Those in debate held that "office" means "prohibition," and is not a name outer departments should use.

sentences.zh: 《周禮》代掌其職者曰氏，國學非代官，不宜曰太師氏。

translations.literal: The Rites of Zhou calls one who acts in another's stead shi; the Directorate of the Sons of the State is not a substitute post, and should not be called Grand Director of Masters.
translations.idiomatic: The Rites of Zhou calls one who acts in another's stead shi; the Directorate of the Sons of the State is not a substitute post, and should not be called Grand Director of Masters.

sentences.zh: 其餘大抵以習俗既久，重難改作，其事不行。

translations.literal: On the rest, they mostly held that custom was long established and reform would be hard; the proposal was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: On the rest, they mostly held that custom was long established and reform would be difficult; the proposal was not carried out.

sentences.zh: 會國學胥吏以餐錢差舛，御史臺按問，坐貶饒州司馬。

translations.literal: It happened that clerks of the Directorate of the Sons of the State had errors in meal money; the Censorate investigated, and he was demoted to military advisor of Rao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that clerks of the Directorate of the Sons of the State had errors in meal money; the Censorate investigated, and he was demoted to military advisor of Rao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 建中初，又拜國子司業。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianzhong he was again appointed Vice Director of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianzhong he was again appointed Vice Director of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 尋選為翰林學士，遷左散騎常侍，加銀青光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Soon he was selected as Academician of the Hanlin Academy, promoted to Regular Attendant of the Left, and granted the silver-blue robe and grand master of the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was selected as Academician of the Hanlin Academy, promoted to Regular Attendant of the Left, and granted the silver-blue robe and Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 尋兼普王元帥參謀，累加光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Soon he also served as staff adviser to Prince Pu the Marshal, and was repeatedly promoted to Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he also served as staff adviser to Prince Pu the Marshal, and was repeatedly promoted to Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 以兩河叛渙之徒初稟朝命，令崇敬以本官兼御史大夫持節宣慰，奉使稱旨。

translations.literal: When the rebel bands of the two He regions first received imperial orders, Gui Chongjing was ordered to serve in his existing post as Concurrent Censor-in-Chief, bearing the staff of office as pacification envoy; he fulfilled the mission to the emperor's satisfaction.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebel bands of the two He regions first received imperial orders, Gui Chongjing was ordered to serve in his existing post as Concurrent Censor-in-Chief, bearing the staff of office as pacification envoy; he fulfilled the mission to the emperor's satisfaction.

sentences.zh: 及還，上表請歸拜墓，許之，賜以繒帛，儒者榮之。

translations.literal: On his return he submitted a memorial requesting leave to return and worship at his ancestors' tombs; permission was granted, and silks were bestowed—a honor for a Confucian.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he submitted a memorial requesting leave to return and worship at his ancestors' tombs; permission was granted, and silks were bestowed—a honor rare among Confucians.

sentences.zh: 尋加特進、檢校戶部尚書，遷工部尚書，並依前翰林學士，充皇太子侍讀。

translations.literal: Soon he was specially promoted to specially advanced, Acting Director of the Department of Public Works, promoted to Director of the Department of Public Works, and still served as Hanlin Academician and tutor to the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was specially promoted to Specially Advanced, Acting Director of the Department of Public Works, then Director of the Department of Public Works, while still serving as Hanlin Academician and tutor to the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 累表辭，以年老乞骸骨，改兵部尚書致仕。

translations.literal: Repeatedly submitting memorials declining office on account of old age and requesting retirement, he was changed to Director of the Department of War and retired.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly submitting memorials declining office on account of old age and requesting retirement, he was reassigned as Director of the Department of War and retired.

sentences.zh: 貞元十五年卒，時年八十，廢朝一日，贈左僕射。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhenyuan he died, aged eighty; court was suspended for one day, and he was posthumously granted Left Vice Director of the Department of State.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Zhenyuan he died, aged eighty; court was suspended for one day, and he was posthumously granted Left Vice Director of the Department of State.

sentences.zh: 子登嗣。

translations.literal: His son Gui Deng succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Gui Deng succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 登，字沖之。

translations.literal: Gui Deng, styled Chongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Deng, styled Chongzhi.

sentences.zh: 雅實弘厚，事紀母以孝稱。

translations.literal: Elegant and solid in character, he was famed for filial service to his stepmother.
translations.idiomatic: Elegant and solid in character, he was famed for filial service to his stepmother.

sentences.zh: 大歷七年，舉孝廉高第，補四門助教。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Dali he placed at the top in the Filial and Incorrupt examination and was appointed assistant instructor of the Four Gates.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Dali he placed at the top in the Filial and Incorrupt examination and was appointed assistant instructor of the Four Gates.

sentences.zh: 貞元初，復登賢良科，自美原尉拜右拾遺。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyuan he again passed the Exemplary Talent examination, and from assistant magistrate of Meiyuan was appointed Right Reminder.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhenyuan he again passed the Exemplary Talent examination, and from assistant magistrate of Meiyuan was appointed Right Reminder.

sentences.zh: 時裴延齡以奸佞有恩，欲為相，諫議大夫陽城上疏切直，德宗赫怒。

translations.literal: At that time Pei Yanling, through treachery and flattery, had the emperor's favor and sought to become chancellor; Remonstrance Grandee Yang Cheng submitted a memorial that was blunt and direct, and Dezong was furious.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Pei Yanling, through treachery and flattery, had the emperor's favor and sought to become chancellor; Remonstrance Grandee Yang Cheng submitted a blunt, direct memorial, and Dezong was furious.

sentences.zh: 右補闕熊執易等亦以危言忤旨。

translations.literal: Right Supplementation Censor Xiong Zhiyi and others also spoke harsh truths and offended the emperor's intent.
translations.idiomatic: Right Supplementation Censor Xiong Zhiyi and others also spoke harsh truths and offended the emperor's intent.

sentences.zh: 初執易草疏成，示登，登愕然曰：「願寄一名。

translations.literal: When Xiong Zhiyi first finished drafting his memorial and showed it to Gui Deng, Gui Deng was startled and said, "I wish to add my name.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiong Zhiyi first finished drafting his memorial and showed it to Gui Deng, Gui Deng was startled and said, "I wish to add my name.

sentences.zh: 雷電之下，安忍令足下獨當！」

translations.literal: Under heaven's thunder and lightning, how can I bear to let you alone bear it!"
translations.idiomatic: Under heaven's thunder and lightning, how can I bear to let you bear it alone!"

sentences.zh: 自是同列切諫。

translations.literal: From then on his colleagues remonstrated together.
translations.idiomatic: From then on his colleagues remonstrated together.

sentences.zh: 登每聯署其奏，無所回避，時人稱重。

translations.literal: Gui Deng each time joined his name to their memorials without evasion, and people of the time respected him.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Deng each time joined his name to their memorials without evasion, and people of the time respected him.

sentences.zh: 轉右補闕、起居舍人，三任十五年。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Right Supplementation Censor and Diarist, serving three terms over fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Right Supplementation Censor and Diarist, serving three terms over fifteen years.

sentences.zh: 同列嘗出其下者，多以馳騖至顯官，而登與右拾遺蔣武，退然自守，不以淹速介意。

translations.literal: Colleagues who had once been below him often rose through ambition to eminent posts, while Gui Deng and Right Reminder Jiang Wu quietly kept themselves and did not mind whether advancement was slow or fast.
translations.idiomatic: Colleagues who had once ranked below Gui Deng often rose through ambition to eminent posts, while Gui Deng and Right Reminder Jiang Wu quietly kept themselves and did not mind whether advancement was slow or fast.

sentences.zh: 後遷兵部員外郎，充皇子侍讀，尋加史館修撰。

translations.literal: Later he was promoted to Assistant Director of the Department of War, served as tutor to the princes, and soon was additionally made History Office compiler.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was promoted to Assistant Director of the Department of War, served as tutor to the princes, and soon was additionally made History Office compiler.

sentences.zh: 順宗初，以東朝舊恩，超拜給事中，旋賜金紫，仍錫衫笏焉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzong's reign, because of old favor from his days in the Eastern Palace, he was abruptly promoted to Supervising Censor, soon granted the gold-purple robe, and also given robe and court tablet.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Shunzong's reign, because of old favor from his days in the Eastern Palace, he was abruptly promoted to Supervising Censor, soon granted the gold-purple robe, and also given robe and court tablet.

sentences.zh: 遷工部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Minister of the Department of Public Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Minister of the Department of Public Works.

sentences.zh: 與孟簡、劉伯芻、蕭俛受詔同翻譯《大乘本生心地觀經》。

translations.literal: Together with Meng Jian, Liu Bochou, and Xiao Mian he received orders to translate the Mahayana Sutra of the Mind-Ground from the Great Vehicle.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Meng Jian, Liu Bochou, and Xiao Mian he received orders to translate the Mahayana Sutra of the Mind-Ground from the Great Vehicle.

sentences.zh: 又為東宮及諸王侍讀，獻《龍樓箴》以諷。

translations.literal: He also served as tutor to the Eastern Palace and the various princes, and presented the "Admonition of the Dragon Tower" as remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: He also served as tutor to the Eastern Palace and the various princes, and presented the "Admonition of the Dragon Tower" as remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 久之，改左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: After a long time he was changed to Regular Attendant of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was changed to Regular Attendant of the Left.

sentences.zh: 因中謝，憲宗問時所切，登以納諫為對，時論美之。

translations.literal: When he came to offer thanks at court, Xianzong asked what was most urgent at the time; Gui Deng answered with accepting remonstrance, and opinion of the time praised him.
translations.idiomatic: When he came to offer thanks at court, Xianzong asked what was most urgent at the time; Gui Deng answered with accepting remonstrance, and opinion of the time praised him.

sentences.zh: 轉兵部侍郎，兼判國子祭酒事，遷工部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Minister of the Department of War, concurrently judged affairs as Director of Sacrifices of the Directorate of Education, and was promoted to Director of the Department of Public Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Minister of the Department of War, concurrently judged affairs as Director of Sacrifices of the Directorate of Education, and was promoted to Director of the Department of Public Works.

sentences.zh: 元和十五年卒，年六十七，贈太子少保。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Yuanhe he died, aged sixty-seven, and was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Yuanhe he died, aged sixty-seven, and was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 登有文學，工草隸。

translations.literal: Gui Deng had literary talent and was skilled in cursive and clerical script.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Deng had literary talent and was skilled in cursive and clerical script.

sentences.zh: 寬博容物。

translations.literal: Broad and tolerant in bearing toward others.
translations.idiomatic: He was broad and tolerant in bearing toward others.

sentences.zh: 嘗使僮飼馬，馬蹄踶，僮怒，擊折馬足，登知而不責。

translations.literal: Once he sent a servant to feed a horse; the horse kicked, and in anger the servant struck and broke the horse's leg. Gui Deng knew of it yet did not punish him.
translations.idiomatic: Once Gui Deng sent a servant to feed a horse; the horse kicked, and in anger the servant struck and broke the horse's leg. Gui Deng knew of it yet did not punish him.

sentences.zh: 晚年頗好服食，有饋金石之藥者，且雲先嘗之矣，登服之不疑。

translations.literal: In his later years he greatly favored taking medicines; someone offered him a mineral drug and said he had already tried it himself—Gui Deng took it without doubt.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years Gui Deng greatly favored taking medicines; someone offered him a mineral drug and claimed he had already tried it himself—Gui Deng took it without doubt.

sentences.zh: 藥發毒幾死，方訊雲未之嘗；

translations.literal: When the drug's poison nearly killed him, he then learned the man had not tried it;
translations.idiomatic: When the drug's poison nearly killed him, he then learned the man had not tried it;

sentences.zh: 他人為之怒，登視之無慍色。

translations.literal: others were angry on his behalf, yet Gui Deng showed no sign of resentment.
translations.idiomatic: others were angry on Gui Deng's behalf, yet Gui Deng showed no sign of resentment.

sentences.zh: 常慕陸象先之為人，議者亦以為近之。

translations.literal: He always admired the conduct of Lu Xiangxian; commentators also held him close to that model.
translations.idiomatic: He always admired the conduct of Lu Xiangxian; commentators also held him close to that model.

sentences.zh: 子融嗣。

translations.literal: His son Gui Rong succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Gui Rong succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 融，進士擢第，自監察拾遺入省，拜工部員外郎，遷考功員外。

translations.literal: Gui Rong passed the jinshi examination, entered the Secretariat from investigating censor and reminder, was appointed Assistant Director of the Department of Public Works, and was promoted to Assistant Director of the Bureau of Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Rong passed the jinshi examination, entered the Secretariat from investigating censor and reminder, was appointed Assistant Director of the Department of Public Works, and was promoted to Assistant Director of the Bureau of Appointments.

sentences.zh: 六年，轉工部郎中，充翰林學士。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was transferred to Director of the Department of Public Works and appointed Academician of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was transferred to Director of the Department of Public Works and appointed Academician of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 八年，正拜舍人。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was formally appointed Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was formally appointed Drafter.

sentences.zh: 九年，轉戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Department of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Department of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 開成元年，兼御史中丞。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaicheng he was additionally made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaicheng he was additionally made Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 湖南觀察使盧周仁違敕進羨餘錢十萬貫。

translations.literal: Hunan observation commissioner Lu Zhouren, violating an edict, submitted surplus funds of one hundred thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan observation commissioner Lu Zhouren, violating an edict, submitted surplus funds of one hundred thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 融奏曰：「天下一家，何非君土？

translations.literal: Gui Rong submitted, "Under Heaven all is one family—what is not the sovereign's soil?
translations.idiomatic: Gui Rong submitted, "Under Heaven all is one family—what is not the sovereign's soil?

sentences.zh: 中外財賦，皆陛下府庫也。

translations.literal: Revenues within and without are all stored in Your Majesty's treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Revenues within and without are all stored in Your Majesty's treasury.

sentences.zh: 周仁輒陳小利，妄設異端，言南方火災，恐成灰燼，進於京國，姑徇私誠。

translations.literal: Lu Zhouren rashly presents a small profit and presumptuously sets up a separate category, alleging that fire disaster in the south may reduce all to ash, and that sending funds to the capital is merely private loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhouren rashly presents a small profit and presumptuously sets up a separate category, alleging that fire disaster in the south may reduce all to ash, and that sending funds to the capital is merely private loyalty.

sentences.zh: 入財貨以希恩，待朝廷而何淺！

translations.literal: He brings wealth to seek favor—how shallow his regard for the court!
translations.idiomatic: He brings wealth to seek favor—how shallow his regard for the court!

sentences.zh: 臣恐天下放效，以羨餘為名，因緣刻剝，生人受弊。

translations.literal: I fear the realm will imitate him, using surplus funds as a pretext to extort and strip the people, who will suffer harm.
translations.idiomatic: I fear the realm will imitate him, using surplus funds as a pretext to extort and strip the people, who will suffer harm.

sentences.zh: 周仁請行重責，以例列籓。

translations.literal: I ask that Lu Zhouren receive heavy punishment as a warning to the other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Lu Zhouren receive heavy punishment as a warning to the other circuits.

sentences.zh: 其所進錢，請還湖南，代貧下租稅。」

translations.literal: As for the funds he submitted, I ask that they be returned to Hunan to replace taxes owed by the poor."
translations.idiomatic: As for the funds he submitted, I ask that they be returned to Hunan to replace taxes owed by the poor."

sentences.zh: 詔周仁所進於河陰院收貯，以備水旱。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that Lu Zhouren's submission be stored at the Heyin depot to prepare for flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that Lu Zhouren's submission be stored at the Heyin depot to prepare for flood and drought.

sentences.zh: 金部員外郎韓益判度支案，子弟受人賂三千餘貫，半是擬贓。

translations.literal: Han Yi, Assistant Director of the Bureau of Coinage, judged revenue cases; his younger relatives accepted bribes of more than three thousand strings, half of which counted as embezzlement.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yi, Assistant Director of the Bureau of Coinage, judged revenue cases; his younger relatives accepted bribes of more than three thousand strings, half of which counted as embezzlement.

sentences.zh: 上問融曰：「韓益所犯，與盧元中、姚康孰甚？」

translations.literal: The emperor asked Gui Rong, "Between what Han Yi committed and what Lu Yuanzhong and Yao Kang did, which is the graver?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked Gui Rong, "Between what Han Yi committed and what Lu Yuanzhong and Yao Kang did, which is the graver?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「元中與康枉破官錢三萬餘貫，益所取受人事，比之殊輕。」

translations.literal: Gui Rong replied, "Lu Yuanzhong and Yao Kang improperly disbursed more than thirty thousand strings of official funds; what Han Yi accepted as bribes from others is comparatively much lighter."
translations.idiomatic: Gui Rong replied, "Lu Yuanzhong and Yao Kang improperly disbursed more than thirty thousand strings of official funds; what Han Yi accepted as bribes from others is comparatively much lighter."

sentences.zh: 乃貶梧州司戶。

translations.literal: Han Yi was then demoted to registrar of Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yi was then demoted to registrar of Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 尋遷京兆尹。

translations.literal: Soon Gui Rong was promoted to metropolitan magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Gui Rong was promoted to metropolitan magistrate.

sentences.zh: 時府司物力不充，特敕賜錢五萬貫；

translations.literal: At that time the metropolitan office lacked sufficient supplies; a special edict bestowed fifty thousand strings;
translations.idiomatic: At that time the metropolitan office lacked sufficient supplies; a special edict bestowed fifty thousand strings;

sentences.zh: 府司以所賜之半還司農寺菜錢，融因對言之。

translations.literal: the office returned half the grant to the Ministry of Agriculture as vegetable money, and Gui Rong spoke of this when answering at court.
translations.idiomatic: the office returned half the grant to the Ministry of Agriculture as vegetable money, and Gui Rong spoke of this when answering at court.

sentences.zh: 上以融學家，因問「『蔬糲』字有賴音，何也？

translations.literal: Since Gui Rong was a scholar, the emperor asked, "'Shu li'—does the character have a reading as 'lai'? Why?
translations.idiomatic: Since Gui Rong was a scholar, the emperor asked, "'Shu li'—does the character have a reading as 'lai'? Why?

sentences.zh: 『糲』是飯之極粗者耶？」

translations.literal: Is 'li' the coarsest grade of rice?'"
translations.idiomatic: Is 'li' the coarsest grade of rice?'"

sentences.zh: 融以義類對之。

translations.literal: Gui Rong answered by analogy of meaning.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Rong answered by analogy of meaning.

sentences.zh: 時兩公主出降，府司供帳事殷，又俯近上巳，曲江賜宴奏請改日。

translations.literal: At that time two princesses were being married off, and the metropolitan office's provisioning was heavy; moreover, as Shangsi Festival drew near, a memorial requested postponing the Qujiang imperial banquet.
translations.idiomatic: At that time two princesses were being married off, and the metropolitan office's provisioning was heavy; moreover, as Shangsi Festival drew near, a memorial requested postponing the Qujiang imperial banquet.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「去年重陽，取九月十九日，未失重陽之意，今改取十三日可也。」

translations.literal: The emperor said, "Last year for Double Ninth we chose the nineteenth of the ninth month, without losing the intent of Double Ninth; this year the thirteenth day will suffice."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Last year for Double Ninth we chose the nineteenth of the ninth month, without losing the intent of Double Ninth; this year the thirteenth day will suffice."

sentences.zh: 既而李固言作相，素不悅融，罷尹。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Li Guyin became chancellor; he had never liked Gui Rong, and Gui Rong was removed as magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Li Guyin became chancellor; he had never liked Gui Rong, and Gui Rong was removed as magistrate.

sentences.zh: 月餘，授秘書監。

translations.literal: After more than a month he was appointed Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a month he was appointed Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 俄而固言罷，楊嗣復輔政，以融權知兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Before long Li Guyin was dismissed, Yang Sifu took power as chancellor, and Gui Rong was appointed acting Vice Minister of the Department of War.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Li Guyin was dismissed, Yang Sifu took power as chancellor, and Gui Rong was appointed acting Vice Minister of the Department of War.

sentences.zh: 一年內拜吏部。

translations.literal: Within one year he was appointed Director of the Department of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Within one year he was appointed Director of the Department of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 三年檢校禮部尚書、興元尹、兼御史大夫，充山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: In the third year he was made Acting Director of the Department of Rites, metropolitan magistrate of Xingyuan, Concurrent Censor-in-Chief, and military commissioner of the Shannan West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was made Acting Director of the Department of Rites, metropolitan magistrate of Xingyuan, Concurrent Censor-in-Chief, and military commissioner of the Shannan West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 融子仁晦、仁翰、仁憲、仁召、仁澤，皆登進士第。

translations.literal: Gui Rong's sons Renhui, Renhan, Renxian, Renzhao, and Renze all passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Rong's sons Renhui, Renhan, Renxian, Renzhao, and Renze all passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 咸通中並至達官。

translations.literal: In the Xiantong era they all reached high office.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xiantong era they all reached high office.

sentences.zh: 奚陟

translations.literal: Xi Zhi
translations.idiomatic: Xi Zhi

sentences.zh: 奚陟，字殷卿，亳州人也。

translations.literal: Xi Zhi, styled Yinqing, was a native of Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Zhi, styled Yinqing, was a native of Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 祖翰繹，天寶中弋陽郡太守。

translations.literal: His grandfather Han Yi served as prefect of Yiyang Commandery during the Tianbao era.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Han Yi served as prefect of Yiyang Commandery during the Tianbao era.

sentences.zh: 陟少好讀書，登進士第，又登制舉文詞清麗科，授弘文館校書，尋拜大理評事。

translations.literal: Zhi from youth loved reading books. He passed the jinshi examination, then also passed the decree examination in the category of refined literary diction, was appointed collator in the Hongwen Institute, and soon afterward was appointed evaluating official in the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: From youth Zhi loved reading. He passed the jinshi examination and then the decree examination in refined literary diction, was appointed collator in the Hongwen Institute, and soon became an evaluating official in the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 佐入吐蕃使，不行，授左拾遺。

translations.literal: He was assigned as aide to the envoy entering Tibet, but did not go; he was appointed Left Remonstrance Official.
translations.idiomatic: He was assigned as aide to the envoy to Tibet but did not go, and was appointed Left Remonstrance Official.

sentences.zh: 丁父母憂，哀毀過禮，親朋湣之。

translations.literal: He fulfilled mourning for his parents; his grief and self-injury exceeded ritual propriety, and relatives and friends pitied him.
translations.idiomatic: Upon the deaths of his parents he mourned with such grief and self-mortification that he exceeded ritual propriety, and relatives and friends pitied him.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸興元，召拜起居郎、翰林學士。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage visited Xingyuan, he was summoned and appointed Master of Ceremonial for the Emperor's Movements and Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor traveled to Xingyuan, Zhi was summoned and appointed Master of Ceremonial for the Emperor's Movements and Hanlin Academician.

sentences.zh: 辭以疾病，久不赴職，改太子司議郎。

translations.literal: He declined on grounds of illness, long did not report to duty, and was reassigned as Secretary for Discussion in the Heir Apparent's Household.
translations.idiomatic: He declined on grounds of illness, long failed to report to duty, and was reassigned as Secretary for Discussion in the Heir Apparent's Household.

sentences.zh: 歷金部、吏部員外郎、左司郎中，彌綸省闥。

translations.literal: He successively served as Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue and Ministry of Personnel and as Director in the Left Department of the Secretariat, managing affairs within the imperial secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as Vice Director in the Ministries of Revenue and Personnel and as Director in the Left Department of the Secretariat, handling affairs within the imperial secretariat.

sentences.zh: 又累奉使，皆稱旨。

translations.literal: He also repeatedly served on missions, and all won imperial approval.
translations.idiomatic: He also undertook repeated missions, all of which pleased the emperor.

sentences.zh: 貞元八年，擢拜中書舍人。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhenyuan, he was promoted and appointed Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Zhenyuan he was promoted to Secretariat Drafter.

sentences.zh: 是歲，江南、淮西大雨為災，令陟勞問巡慰，所在人安悅之。

translations.literal: That year heavy rains brought disaster to Jiangnan and Huaixi; Zhi was ordered to offer consolation and tour the regions on inspection, and wherever he went the people were settled and pleased.
translations.idiomatic: That year heavy rains brought disaster to Jiangnan and Huaixi; Zhi was ordered to tour the regions offering consolation, and wherever he went the people were reassured and grateful.

sentences.zh: 中書省故事，姑息胥徒，以常在宰相左右也，陟皆以公道處之。

translations.literal: By precedent in the Secretariat, clerks and runners were indulged because they were constantly at the chancellors' side; Zhi handled them all with impartial justice.
translations.idiomatic: By Secretariat precedent, clerks and runners were indulged because they were always at the chancellors' side; Zhi treated them all with impartial justice.

sentences.zh: 先是右省雜給，率分等第，皆據職田頃畝，即主書所受與右史等。

translations.literal: Previously, miscellaneous allowances in the Right Secretariat were generally divided by grade, all according to the acreage of official fields — that is, what the chief clerks received was equal to what the right historians received.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, miscellaneous allowances in the Right Secretariat were generally apportioned by rank according to the acreage of official fields, so that chief clerks received the same share as right historians.

sentences.zh: 陟乃約以料錢為率，自是主書所得減拾遺。

translations.literal: Zhi then set the standard according to stipend funds; from this the chief clerks' share was reduced below that of the remonstrance officials.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi then set the standard according to stipend funds, and from that time the chief clerks' share was reduced below that of the remonstrance officials.

sentences.zh: 時中書令李晟所請紙筆雜給，皆不受；

translations.literal: At the time the paper, brush, and miscellaneous supplies requested by Chief Councilor Li Sheng were all refused;
translations.idiomatic: At the time the paper, brushes, and miscellaneous supplies requested by Chief Councilor Li Sheng were all refused;

sentences.zh: 但告雜事舍人，令且貯之，他日便悉以遺舍人。

translations.literal: he only told the miscellaneous-affairs drafter to store them for the time being, and on another day gave them all to the drafters.
translations.idiomatic: he only told the miscellaneous-affairs drafter to store them temporarily, and later gave them all to the drafters.

sentences.zh: 前例，雜事舍人自攜私入，陟以所得均分省內官。

translations.literal: By former precedent the miscellaneous-affairs drafter brought private goods in; Zhi divided what he received equally among officials within the secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: By former precedent the miscellaneous-affairs drafter brought in private goods; Zhi divided what he received equally among officials within the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 又躬親庶務，下至園蔬，皆悉自點閱，人以為難，陟處之無倦。

translations.literal: He also personally attended to routine affairs, down to garden vegetables, all personally inspected; people regarded it as difficult, but Zhi handled it without weariness.
translations.idiomatic: He also personally attended to routine affairs down to garden vegetables, inspecting everything himself; people thought it arduous, but Zhi handled it without tiring.

sentences.zh: 遷刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 裴延齡惡京兆尹李充有能政，專意陷害之，誣奏充結陸贄，數厚賂遺金帛。

translations.literal: Pei Yanling hated Jingzhao Intendant Li Chong for his capable administration and deliberately set out to entrap him, falsely memorializing that Chong had allied with Lu Zhi and repeatedly sent lavish gifts of gold and silk.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Yanling hated Jingzhao Intendant Li Chong for his capable administration and deliberately set out to entrap him, falsely memorializing that Chong had allied with Lu Zhi and repeatedly sent him lavish gifts of gold and silk.

sentences.zh: 充既貶官，又奏充比者妄破用京兆府錢穀至多，請令比部勾覆，以比部郎中崔元翰陷充，怨惡贄也。

translations.literal: After Chong was demoted, he further memorialized that Chong had recently misappropriated an enormous amount of the Jingzhao Metropolitan Government's funds and grain, requesting that the Audit Bureau conduct a review; he used Audit Bureau Director Cui Yuanhan to entrap Chong, out of hatred for Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: After Chong was demoted, Yanling further memorialized that Chong had recently misappropriated vast sums from the Jingzhao Metropolitan Government's treasury, requesting an audit by the Audit Bureau; he used Audit Bureau Director Cui Yuanhan to entrap Chong, motivated by hatred for Zhi.

sentences.zh: 詔許之。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the request.

sentences.zh: 元翰曲附延齡，劾治府史。

translations.literal: Yuanhan bent to Yanling's side and prosecuted the metropolitan clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhan curried favor with Yanling and prosecuted the metropolitan clerks.

sentences.zh: 府史到者，雖無過犯，皆笞決以立威，時論喧然。

translations.literal: Clerks who were summoned, though without offense, were all flogged to establish authority; public opinion was in uproar.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks who were summoned, though guilty of no offense, were all flogged to establish authority, and public opinion was in uproar.

sentences.zh: 陟乃躬自閱視府案，具得其實，奏言：「據度支奏，京兆府貞元九年兩稅及已前諸色羨餘錢，共六十八萬餘貫，李充並妄破用。

translations.literal: Zhi then personally reviewed the metropolitan records and fully obtained the facts, memorializing: "According to the Finance Commission's memorial, the Jingzhao Metropolitan Government's surplus funds from the two-tax levies of the ninth year of Zhenyuan and earlier miscellaneous items totaled more than 680,000 strings of cash, all of which Li Chong was alleged to have misappropriated without authorization.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi then personally reviewed the metropolitan records and established the facts, memorializing: "According to the Finance Commission's memorial, surplus funds from the Jingzhao Metropolitan Government's two-tax levies of the ninth year of Zhenyuan and earlier miscellaneous items totaled more than 680,000 strings of cash, all of which Li Chong was alleged to have misappropriated without authorization.

sentences.zh: 今所勾勘，一千二百貫已來是諸縣供館驛加破，及在諸色人戶腹內合收，其斛鬥共三十二萬石，唯三百餘石諸色輸納所由欠折，其餘並是準敕及度支符牒，給用已盡。」

translations.literal: The present audit shows that amounts of 1,200 strings and below consisted of additional expenditures by various counties for relay stations and posthouses, and grain to be collected within miscellaneous household quotas, totaling 320,000 bushels; only more than 300 bushels involved shortages in delivery by the responsible parties for miscellaneous tax items. The remainder was fully disbursed in accordance with imperial edicts and Finance Commission directives."
translations.idiomatic: The present audit shows that amounts of 1,200 strings and below were additional expenditures by various counties for relay stations and posthouses, and grain to be collected within miscellaneous household quotas, totaling 320,000 bushels; only more than 300 bushels involved shortages in delivery by the responsible parties for miscellaneous tax items. The remainder was fully disbursed in accordance with imperial edicts and Finance Commission directives."

sentences.zh: 陟之寬平守法，多如此類。

translations.literal: Zhi's leniency, fairness, and observance of law were mostly of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi's leniency, fairness, and fidelity to law were mostly of this kind.

sentences.zh: 元翰既不遂其誌，因此憤恚而卒。

translations.literal: Yuanhan, unable to achieve his aim, therefore died in anger and resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhan, unable to achieve his aim, died in anger and resentment.

sentences.zh: 陟尋以本官知吏部選事，銓綜平允，有能名，遷吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: Zhi soon thereafter, in his existing office, oversaw selection affairs in the Ministry of Personnel; his evaluations were fair and even, and he gained a reputation for ability; he was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi soon oversaw selection affairs in the Ministry of Personnel in his existing office; his evaluations were fair and even and he gained a reputation for ability, and he was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 所蒞之官，時以為稱職。

translations.literal: Every office he held was at the time regarded as fitting the post.
translations.idiomatic: Every office he held was regarded at the time as a good fit.

sentences.zh: 貞元十五年卒，年五十五，贈禮部尚書。

translations.literal: He died in the fifteenth year of Zhenyuan, aged fifty-five; he was posthumously awarded Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fifteenth year of Zhenyuan at the age of fifty-five and was posthumously awarded Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 張薦

translations.literal: Zhang Jian
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jian

sentences.zh: 張薦，字孝舉，深州陸澤人。

translations.literal: Zhang Jian, styled Xiaoju, was a native of Luzhe in Shen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jian, styled Xiaoju, was a native of Luzhe in Shen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 祖翾，字文成，聰警絕綸，書無不覽。

translations.literal: His grandfather Xuan, styled Wencheng, was exceptionally quick-witted and unmatched in talent; there was no book he did not read.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Xuan, styled Wencheng, was exceptionally quick-witted and brilliant; there was no book he did not read.

sentences.zh: 為兒童時，夢紫色大鳥，五彩成文，降於家庭。

translations.literal: When he was a child, he dreamed of a great purple bird with five-colored patterned plumage descending into the family courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: As a child he dreamed of a great purple bird with five-colored patterned plumage descending into the family courtyard.

sentences.zh: 其祖謂之曰：「五色赤文，鳳也；

translations.literal: His grandfather told him: "Five-colored red writing is the phoenix;
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather told him: "Five-colored red writing is the phoenix;

sentences.zh: 紫文，趯翾也，為鳳之佐，吾兒當以文章瑞於明廷。」

translations.literal: purple writing is Yue Xuan — the phoenix's assistant. My boy will bring literary glory to the bright court through his writings."
translations.idiomatic: purple writing is Yue Xuan, the phoenix's assistant. My boy will bring literary glory to the bright court through his writings."

sentences.zh: 因以為名字。

translations.literal: On this basis his name and style were chosen.
translations.idiomatic: On this basis his name and style were chosen.

sentences.zh: 初登進士第，對策尤工，考功員外郎謇味道賞之曰：「如此生，天下無雙矣！」

translations.literal: When he first passed the jinshi examination, his policy response was especially skilled; Evaluation Officer Jian Weidao praised him: "Such a young man — there is no peer under Heaven!"
translations.idiomatic: When he first passed the jinshi examination, his policy response was especially accomplished; Evaluation Officer Jian Weidao praised him: "Such a young man — there is no peer under Heaven!"

sentences.zh: 調授岐王府參軍。

translations.literal: He was appointed and assigned as aide in the household of the Prince of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed aide in the household of the Prince of Qi.

sentences.zh: 又應下筆成章及才高位下、詞標文苑等科。

translations.literal: He also entered the examinations for Instant Composition, High Talent with Low Rank, and Literary Excellence in the Garden of Letters.
translations.idiomatic: He also entered the examinations for Instant Composition, High Talent with Low Rank, and Literary Excellence in the Garden of Letters.

sentences.zh: 翾凡應八舉，皆登甲科。

translations.literal: Xuan in all entered eight examinations and each time passed in the top grade.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan entered eight examinations in all and each time passed in the top grade.

sentences.zh: 再授長安尉，遷鴻臚丞。

translations.literal: He was again appointed bailiff of Chang'an and was transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: He was again appointed bailiff of Chang'an and transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 凡四參選，判策為銓府之最。

translations.literal: In all he participated in four selection rounds; his graded policy responses ranked highest in the selection office.
translations.idiomatic: He participated in four selection rounds in all; his graded policy responses ranked highest in the selection office.

sentences.zh: 員外郎員半千謂人曰：「張子之文如青錢，萬簡萬中，未聞退時。」

translations.literal: Vice Director Yuan Banqian told others: "Master Zhang's writings are like green cash coins — ten thousand selections, ten thousand hits; never have I heard of a miss."
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director Yuan Banqian told others: "Master Zhang's writings are like green cash coins — ten thousand selections, ten thousand hits; never have I heard of a miss."

sentences.zh: 時流重之，目為「青錢學士」。

translations.literal: Men of the age esteemed him and called him the "Green Cash Academician."
translations.idiomatic: Men of the age esteemed him and called him the "Green Cash Academician."

sentences.zh: 然性褊躁，不持士行，尤為端士所惡，姚崇甚薄之。

translations.literal: Yet his nature was narrow and impetuous; he did not maintain the conduct of a gentleman, and upright men especially detested him; Yao Chong held him in very low regard.
translations.idiomatic: Yet his nature was narrow and impetuous; he did not maintain the conduct of a gentleman, and upright men especially detested him; Yao Chong held him in very low regard.

sentences.zh: 開元初，澄正風俗，翾為御史李全交所糾，言翾語多譏刺，時坐貶嶺南。

translations.literal: In the early Kaiyuan era, when customs were being rectified, Xuan was impeached by Censor Li Quanjiao, who said Xuan's words were mostly sarcastic and cutting; at the time he was punished by demotion to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Kaiyuan era, when customs were being rectified, Xuan was impeached by Censor Li Quanjiao, who charged that his words were mostly sarcastic and cutting; at the time he was demoted to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書李日知奏論，乃追敕移於近處。

translations.literal: Minister of Justice Li Rizhi memorialized in discussion, and an edict was then sent recalling him to a nearer place.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Justice Li Rizhi memorialized in his defense, and an edict was then sent recalling him to a nearer place.

sentences.zh: 開元中，入為司門員外郎卒。

translations.literal: In the Kaiyuan era he entered the capital as Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice and died in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kaiyuan era he entered the capital as Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice and died in office.

sentences.zh: 翾下筆敏速，著述尤多，言頗詼諧。

translations.literal: Xuan wrote with quick fluency and produced especially many works; his language was quite humorous.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan wrote with quick fluency and produced especially many works; his language was quite humorous.

sentences.zh: 是時天下知名，無賢不肖，皆記誦其文。

translations.literal: At that time he was famous throughout the realm; whether worthy or unworthy, all memorized his writings.
translations.idiomatic: At that time he was famous throughout the realm; whether worthy or unworthy, all memorized his writings.

sentences.zh: 天後朝，中使馬仙童陷默啜，默啜謂仙童曰：「張文成在否？」

translations.literal: In the era of Empress Wu, when the palace envoy Ma Xiantong was trapped by Mohe, Mohe asked Xiantong: "Is Zhang Wencheng still alive?"
translations.idiomatic: In the era of Empress Wu, when the palace envoy Ma Xiantong was trapped by Mohe, Mohe asked Xiantong: "Is Zhang Wencheng still alive?"

sentences.zh: 曰：「近自御史貶官。」

translations.literal: He replied: "Recently he was demoted from censor."
translations.idiomatic: He replied: "Recently he was demoted from censor."

sentences.zh: 默啜曰：「國有此人而不用，漢無能為也。」

translations.literal: Mohe said: "A state that has such a man and does not employ him — the Han are incapable."
translations.idiomatic: Mohe said: "A state that has such a man and does not employ him — the Han are incapable."

sentences.zh: 新羅、日本東夷諸蕃，尤重其文，每遣使入朝，必重出金貝以購其文，其才名遠播如此。

translations.literal: Silla, Japan, and the various eastern barbarian tribes especially prized his writings; whenever they sent envoys to court they would bring out gold and shells to purchase his works — his literary fame spread so far.
translations.idiomatic: Silla, Japan, and the various eastern barbarian tribes especially prized his writings; whenever they sent envoys to court they would bring out gold and shells to purchase his works — his literary fame spread so far.

sentences.zh: 薦少精史傳，顏真卿一見嘆賞之。

translations.literal: Jian from youth was skilled in history and biography; Yan Zhenqing sighed in admiration at first sight of him.
translations.idiomatic: Jian from youth was skilled in history and biography; Yan Zhenqing sighed in admiration at first sight of him.

sentences.zh: 天寶中，浙西觀察使李涵表薦其才可當史任，乃詔授左司禦率府兵曹參軍。

translations.literal: In the Tianbao era, Zhexi Observation Commissioner Li Han memorialized that Jian's talent was fit for historiographical duty; an edict then appointed him Military Affairs Clerk in the Left Bureau of the Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tianbao era, Zhexi Observation Commissioner Li Han memorialized that Jian's talent was fit for historiographical duty; an edict then appointed him Military Affairs Clerk in the Left Bureau of the Imperial Guard.

sentences.zh: 既至闕下，以母老疾，竟不拜命。

translations.literal: After he reached the capital, because his mother was old and ill, he ultimately did not accept the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: After he reached the capital, because his mother was old and ill, he ultimately did not accept the appointment.

sentences.zh: 母喪闋，禮部侍郎於邵舉前事以聞，召充史館修撰，兼陽翟尉。

translations.literal: When the period of mourning for his mother ended, Vice Minister of Rites Yu Shao reported the earlier matter to the throne; he was summoned to serve as historiographer in the History Institute, concurrently as bailiff of Yangdi.
translations.idiomatic: When the period of mourning for his mother ended, Vice Minister of Rites Yu Shao reported the earlier matter to the throne; he was summoned to serve as historiographer in the History Institute, concurrently as bailiff of Yangdi.

sentences.zh: 硃泚之亂，變姓名伏匿城中，因著《史遁先生傳》。

translations.literal: During Zhu Ci's rebellion he changed his name and hid within the city, and accordingly wrote the "Biography of Master Shitun."
translations.idiomatic: During Zhu Ci's rebellion he changed his name and hid within the city, and accordingly wrote the "Biography of Master Shitun."

sentences.zh: 德宗還宮，擢拜左拾遺。

translations.literal: When Dezong returned to the palace, he was promoted and appointed Left Remonstrance Official.
translations.idiomatic: When Dezong returned to the palace, he was promoted and appointed Left Remonstrance Official.

sentences.zh: 貞元元年冬，上親郊。

translations.literal: In the winter of the first year of Zhenyuan, the emperor personally performed the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the first year of Zhenyuan, the emperor personally performed the suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 時初克復，簿籍多失，禮文錯亂，乃以薦為太常博士，參典禮儀。

translations.literal: At that time, just after recovery, registers were mostly lost and ritual texts were in disorder; Jian was therefore made Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to assist in managing ceremonial protocol.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, just after recovery, registers were mostly lost and ritual texts were in disorder; Jian was therefore made Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to assist in managing ceremonial protocol.

sentences.zh: 四年，回紇和親，以檢校右僕射、刑部尚書關播充使，送鹹安公主入蕃，以薦為判官，轉殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, when the Uyghurs made a marriage alliance, the Acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Minister of Justice Guan Bo was made envoy to escort Princess Xian'an into the frontier; Jian served as aide and was transferred to Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, when the Uyghurs made a marriage alliance, Acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Minister of Justice Guan Bo was made envoy to escort Princess Xian'an into the frontier; Jian served as aide and was transferred to Attending Censor.

sentences.zh: 使還，轉工部員外郎，改戶部本司郎中。

translations.literal: After the mission returned, he was transferred to Vice Director in the Ministry of Public Works and reassigned as Director in the Ministry of Revenue in his home ministry.
translations.idiomatic: After the mission returned, he was transferred to Vice Director in the Ministry of Public Works and reassigned as Director in the Ministry of Revenue in his home ministry.

sentences.zh: 十一年，拜諫議大夫，仍充中館修撰。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was appointed Remonstrance Official and continued to serve as historiographer in the Central Institute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was appointed Remonstrance Official and continued to serve as historiographer in the Central Institute.

sentences.zh: 時裴延齡恃寵，譖毀士大夫。

translations.literal: At the time Pei Yanling relied on favor and slandered scholar-officials.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Pei Yanling relied on imperial favor and slandered scholar-officials.

sentences.zh: 薦欲上書論之，屢揚言未果。

translations.literal: Jian wished to submit a memorial discussing this and repeatedly announced his intent, but did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Jian wished to submit a memorial discussing this and repeatedly announced his intent, but never carried it through.

sentences.zh: 延齡聞之怒，奏曰：「諫官論朝政得失，史官書人君善惡，則領史職者不宜兼諫議。」

translations.literal: Yanling heard of this and was angry; he memorialized: "Remonstrance officials discuss the gains and losses of court governance, and historiographers record the ruler's good and evil — therefore one who holds historiographical office should not concurrently hold remonstrance office."
translations.idiomatic: Yanling heard of this and was angry; he memorialized: "Remonstrance officials discuss the gains and losses of court governance, and historiographers record the ruler's good and evil — therefore one who holds historiographical office should not concurrently hold remonstrance office."

sentences.zh: 德宗以為然。

translations.literal: Dezong thought this correct.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong thought this correct.

sentences.zh: 薦為諫議月餘，改秘書少監。

translations.literal: Jian had been Remonstrance Official for little more than a month when he was reassigned as Vice Director of the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: Jian had been Remonstrance Official for little more than a month when he was reassigned as Vice Director of the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 延齡排擯不已，會差使冊回紇毗伽懷信可汗及吊祭，乃命薦兼御史中丞，入回紇。

translations.literal: Yanling kept pressing him out; when missions were assigned to invest the Uyghur Qaghan Pijia Huaixin and to offer condolences, Jian was ordered to serve concurrently as Imperial Censor and enter the Uyghur lands.
translations.idiomatic: Yanling kept pressing him out; when missions were assigned to invest the Uyghur Qaghan Pijia Huaixin and to offer condolences, Jian was ordered to serve concurrently as Imperial Censor and enter the Uyghur lands.

sentences.zh: 二十年，吐蕃贊普死，以薦為工部侍郎、兼御史大夫，充入吐蕃吊祭使。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, when the Tibetan tsenpo died, Jian was made Vice Minister of Public Works and Concurrent Imperial Censor and sent as envoy to Tibet to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, when the Tibetan tsenpo died, Jian was made Vice Minister of Public Works and Concurrent Imperial Censor and sent as envoy to Tibet to offer condolences.

sentences.zh: 涉蕃界二千餘里，至赤嶺東被病，歿於紇壁驛，吐蕃傳其柩以歸。

translations.literal: He crossed more than two thousand li of Tibetan territory, fell ill east of Chiling, and died at Hewall Post Station; the Tibetans conveyed his coffin back.
translations.idiomatic: He crossed more than two thousand li of Tibetan territory, fell ill east of Chiling, and died at Hewall Post Station; the Tibetans conveyed his coffin back.

sentences.zh: 順宗即位，兇問至，詔贈禮部尚書。

translations.literal: When Shunzong took the throne and news of his death arrived, an edict posthumously awarded him Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: When Shunzong took the throne and news of his death arrived, an edict posthumously awarded him Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 薦自拾遺至侍郎，僅二十年，皆兼史館修撰。

translations.literal: From Remonstrance Official to Vice Minister, barely twenty years, he always concurrently served as historiographer in the History Institute.
translations.idiomatic: From Remonstrance Official to Vice Minister — barely twenty years — he always concurrently served as historiographer in the History Institute.

sentences.zh: 三使絕域，皆兼憲職。

translations.literal: On three missions to distant regions he always concurrently held censorial office.
translations.idiomatic: On three missions to distant regions he always concurrently held censorial office.

sentences.zh: 以博洽多能，敏於占對被選。

translations.literal: Because he was broadly learned and multitalented and quick in extemporaneous response, he was selected.
translations.idiomatic: He was selected because he was broadly learned and multitalented and quick in extemporaneous response.

sentences.zh: 有文集三十卷，及所撰《五服圖》、《宰輔略》、《靈怪集》、《江左寓居錄》等，並傳於時。

translations.literal: He had a collected works in thirty juan, and works he compiled such as the "Diagram of Five Ranks of Mourning Garments," "Brief Account of Chancellors," "Collection of Marvels," and "Record of Residence in the Lower Yangtze," all circulated in his time.
translations.idiomatic: He had a collected works in thirty juan, and works he compiled such as the "Diagram of Five Ranks of Mourning Garments," "Brief Account of Chancellors," "Collection of Marvels," and "Record of Residence in the Lower Yangtze," all circulated in his time.

sentences.zh: 子又新、希復，皆登進士第。

translations.literal: His sons Youxin and Xifu both passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Youxin and Xifu both passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 又新，幼工文，善於傅會。

translations.literal: Youxin from childhood was skilled in letters and adept at ingratiating himself.
translations.idiomatic: Youxin from childhood was skilled in letters and adept at ingratiating himself.

sentences.zh: 長慶中，宰相李逢吉用事，翰林學士李紳深為穆宗所寵，逢吉惡之；

translations.literal: In the Changqing era, Chancellor Li Fengji held power; Hanlin Academician Li Shen was deeply favored by Muzong; Fengji hated him;
translations.idiomatic: In the Changqing era, Chancellor Li Fengji held power; Hanlin Academician Li Shen was deeply favored by Muzong; Fengji hated him;

sentences.zh: 求朝臣中兇險敢言者掎摭紳陰事，俾暴揚於搢紳間。

translations.literal: he sought among court officials those fierce and daring in speech to seize upon Shen's private affairs and expose them among the gentry.
translations.idiomatic: he sought among court officials those fierce and daring in speech to seize upon Shen's private affairs and expose them among the gentry.

sentences.zh: 又新與拾遺李續之、劉棲楚，尤蒙逢吉睠待，指為鷹犬。

translations.literal: Youxin, together with Remonstrance Officials Li Xuzhi and Liu Qichu, was especially favored by Fengji and designated his hawk and hound.
translations.idiomatic: Youxin, together with Remonstrance Officials Li Xuzhi and Liu Qichu, was especially favored by Fengji and designated his hawk and hound.

sentences.zh: 穆宗崩，昭湣初即位，又新等構紳，敗端州司馬，朝臣表賀，又至中書賀宰相。

translations.literal: When Muzong died and Zhaomin first took the throne, Youxin and the others framed Shen; he was defeated and made prefectural aide at Duanzhou; court officials submitted congratulations, and they again went to the Secretariat to congratulate the chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: When Muzong died and Zhaomin first took the throne, Youxin and the others framed Shen; he was defeated and made prefectural aide at Duanzhou; court officials submitted congratulations, and they again went to the Secretariat to congratulate the chancellor.

sentences.zh: 及門，門者止之曰：「請少留，緣張補闕在齋內與相公談。」

translations.literal: Upon reaching the gate, the gatekeeper stopped them: "Please wait a moment — Remonstrance Official Zhang is in the study talking with the Chancellor."
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching the gate, the gatekeeper stopped them: "Please wait a moment — Remonstrance Official Zhang is in the study talking with the Chancellor."

sentences.zh: 俄而又新揮汗而出，旅揖群官曰：「端溪之事，又新不敢多讓。」

translations.literal: Soon Youxin came out waving sweat and bowed to the assembled officials: "As for the affair at Duanxi, Youxin dares not claim much credit."
translations.idiomatic: Soon Youxin came out waving sweat and bowed to the assembled officials: "As for the affair at Duanxi, Youxin dares not claim much credit."

sentences.zh: 人皆辟易憚之。

translations.literal: All shrank back and feared him.
translations.idiomatic: All shrank back and feared him.

sentences.zh: 與續之等七人，時號「八關十六子」。

translations.literal: Together with Xuzhi and six others, they were at the time called the "Eight Passes and Sixteen Sons."
translations.idiomatic: Together with Xuzhi and six others, they were at the time called the "Eight Passes and Sixteen Sons."

sentences.zh: 寶歷三年，逢吉出為山南東道節度使，請又新為副使，李續之為行軍司馬。

translations.literal: In the third year of Baoli, Fengji went out as military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit and requested Youxin as vice commissioner and Li Xuzhi as campaigning staff officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Baoli, Fengji went out as military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit and requested Youxin as vice commissioner and Li Xuzhi as campaigning staff officer.

sentences.zh: 逢吉為宰相時，用門下省主事田伾。
