translations.literal: When Fengji was chancellor he employed Chief Clerk Tian Si of the Gate Department.
translations.idiomatic: When Fengji was chancellor he employed Chief Clerk Tian Si of the Gate Department.

sentences.zh: 伾犯贓亡命，逢吉保之於外。

translations.literal: Si committed corruption and fled as a fugitive; Fengji sheltered him outside.
translations.idiomatic: Si committed corruption and fled as a fugitive; Fengji sheltered him outside.

sentences.zh: 及罷相，裴度發其事，逢吉坐罰俸。

translations.literal: When he was removed as chancellor, Pei Du exposed the matter; Fengji was punished by forfeiture of salary.
translations.idiomatic: When he was removed as chancellor, Pei Du exposed the matter; Fengji was punished by forfeiture of salary.

sentences.zh: 又詔曰：「朕在億兆人之上，不令而人化，不言而人信者，法也。

translations.literal: Another edict stated: "I stand above hundreds of millions of people; that the people are transformed without my issuing orders and trust me without my speaking — this is law.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "I stand above hundreds of millions of people; that the people are transformed without my issuing orders and trust me without my speaking — this is law.

sentences.zh: 法行則君主重，法廢則朝廷輕。

translations.literal: When law is enforced the ruler's weight is heavy; when law is abandoned the court is light.
translations.idiomatic: When law is enforced the ruler's weight is heavy; when law is abandoned the court is light.

sentences.zh: 田伾常掛亡命之章，偷請養賢之祿，跡在搜捕，公行人間，而更冒選吏曹，顯擬郡佐。

translations.literal: Tian Si long bore the mark of a fugitive, stealthily requesting the stipend meant to nurture talent; though sought in arrest, he walked openly among the people, yet further presumed upon selection in the clerical bureau and was openly nominated as a prefectural aide.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Si long bore the mark of a fugitive, stealthily requesting the stipend meant to nurture talent; though sought in arrest, he walked openly among the people, yet further presumed upon selection in the clerical bureau and was openly nominated as a prefectural aide.

sentences.zh: 及黃樞覆驗，烏府追擒，證逮皆明，奸狀盡得。

translations.literal: When the Yellow Pivot reviewed and verified, and the Censorate pursued and seized him, the evidence and arrests were all clear and the wicked conduct fully obtained.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yellow Pivot reviewed and verified, and the Censorate pursued and seized him, the evidence and arrests were all clear and the wicked conduct fully established.

sentences.zh: 三移憲牒，一無申陳。

translations.literal: Three times the censorial warrant was sent; not once was there a reply.
translations.idiomatic: Three times the censorial warrant was sent; not once was there a reply.

sentences.zh: 眾狀滿前，群議溢耳，終則步健不至，瑯珰空來。

translations.literal: Charges filled the fore, public discussion overflowed the ears — yet in the end no swift steps arrived and only empty clanking came.
translations.idiomatic: Charges filled the fore, public discussion overflowed the ears — yet in the end no swift steps arrived and only empty clanking came.

sentences.zh: 蔑視紀綱，頗同侮謔，顧茲參畫，負我上臺。

translations.literal: He scorned discipline and regulation, much like mockery; considering this counsel, he failed my high platform.
translations.idiomatic: He scorned discipline and regulation, much like mockery; considering this counsel, he failed my high platform.

sentences.zh: 閱視連名，伊爾二子，又新可汀州刺史，李續之可涪州刺史。」

translations.literal: Reviewing the linked names — you two — Youxin may be made Prefect of Tingzhou, and Li Xuzhi may be made Prefect of Fu Prefecture."
translations.idiomatic: Reviewing the linked names — you two — Youxin may be made Prefect of Tingzhou, and Li Xuzhi may be made Prefect of Fu Prefecture."

sentences.zh: 及逢吉致仕，李訓用事，復召二子為尚書郎。

translations.literal: When Fengji retired, Li Xun held power and again summoned the two sons as directors in the ministries.
translations.idiomatic: When Fengji retired, Li Xun held power and again summoned the two sons as directors in the ministries.

sentences.zh: 訓貶，復貶而卒。

translations.literal: When Xun was demoted, they were again demoted and died.
translations.idiomatic: When Xun was demoted, they were again demoted and died.

sentences.zh: 希復子讀，登進士第，有俊才。

translations.literal: Xifu's son Du passed the jinshi examination and had outstanding talent.
translations.idiomatic: Xifu's son Du passed the jinshi examination and had outstanding talent.

sentences.zh: 累官至中書舍人、禮部侍郎，典貢舉，時稱得士。

translations.literal: He rose through repeated offices to Secretariat Drafter and Vice Minister of Rites, directed the examinations, and at the time was praised for obtaining good men.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through repeated offices to Secretariat Drafter and Vice Minister of Rites, directed the examinations, and at the time was praised for obtaining good men.

sentences.zh: 位終尚書左丞。

translations.literal: He ended his career as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He ended his career as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 蔣乂

translations.literal: Jiang Yi
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Yi

sentences.zh: 蔣乂，字德源，常州義興人也。

translations.literal: Jiang Yi, styled Deyuan, was a native of Yixing in Chang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Yi, styled Deyuan, was a native of Yixing in Chang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 祖瑰，太子洗馬，開元中弘文館學士。

translations.literal: His grandfather Gui served as Groom of the Heir Apparent's Stables and was a Hanlin academician in the Hongwen Institute in the Kaiyuan era.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Gui served as Groom of the Heir Apparent's Stables and was a Hanlin academician in the Hongwen Institute in the Kaiyuan era.

sentences.zh: 父將明，累遷至左司郎中、國子司業、集賢殿學士、副知院事，代為名儒。

translations.literal: His father Jiangming rose through repeated offices to Director in the Left Department of the Secretariat, Vice Director of the Directorate of Education, academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and deputy director of the institute — generation after generation a famous Confucian scholar.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jiangming rose through repeated offices to Director in the Left Department of the Secretariat, Vice Director of the Directorate of Education, academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and deputy director of the institute — generation after generation a famous Confucian scholar.

sentences.zh: 而乂，史官吳兢之外孫，以外舍富墳史，幼便記覽不倦。

translations.literal: Yi was the maternal grandson of historiographer Wu Jian; because the maternal household was rich in historical documents, from childhood he memorized and reviewed without tiring.
translations.idiomatic: Yi was the maternal grandson of historiographer Wu Jian; because the maternal household was rich in historical documents, from childhood he memorized and reviewed without tiring.

sentences.zh: 七歲時，誦庾信《哀江南賦》，數遍而成誦在口，以聰悟強力，聞於親黨間。

translations.literal: At age seven he recited Yu Xin's "Lament for the South of the River"; after several repetitions he could recite it by heart, and for keen intelligence and strength he was known among kin and neighbors.
translations.idiomatic: At age seven he recited Yu Xin's "Lament for the South of the River"; after several repetitions he could recite it by heart, and for keen intelligence and strength he was known among kin and neighbors.

sentences.zh: 弱冠博通群籍，而史才尤長。

translations.literal: In his weak year he broadly mastered the classics, and his talent for history was especially outstanding.
translations.idiomatic: In his weak year he broadly mastered the classics, and his talent for history was especially outstanding.

sentences.zh: 其父在集賢時，以兵亂之後，圖籍混雜，乃白執政，請攜乂入院，令整比之。

translations.literal: When his father was at the Hall of Assembled Worthies, after the military chaos books and registers were mixed in disorder; he reported to those in power and requested to bring Yi into the institute and have him put them in order.
translations.idiomatic: When his father was at the Hall of Assembled Worthies, after the military chaos books and registers were mixed in disorder; he reported to those in power and requested to bring Yi into the institute and have him put them in order.

sentences.zh: 宰相張鎰見而奇之，乃署為集賢小職。

translations.literal: Chancellor Zhang Yi saw him and marveled; he was appointed to a minor post in the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Zhang Yi saw him and marveled; he was appointed to a minor post in the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 乂編次逾年，於亂中勒成部帙，得二萬餘卷，再遷王屋尉，充太常禮院修撰。

translations.literal: Yi compiled and arranged them for more than a year; amid the chaos he completed the sets and obtained more than twenty thousand juan; he was twice transferred to bailiff of Wangwu and served as compiler in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ritual Office.
translations.idiomatic: Yi compiled and arranged them for more than a year; amid the chaos he completed the sets and obtained more than twenty thousand juan; he was twice transferred to bailiff of Wangwu and served as compiler in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ritual Office.

sentences.zh: 貞元九年，轉右拾遺，充史館修撰。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhenyuan he was transferred to Right Remonstrance Official and served as historiographer in the History Institute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Zhenyuan he was transferred to Right Remonstrance Official and served as historiographer in the History Institute.

sentences.zh: 十三年，以故河中節度使張茂昭弟光祿少卿同正茂宗尚義章公主，茂宗方居母喪，有詔起復雲麾將軍成禮。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, because the younger brother of the former military commissioner of Hezhong, Zhang Maozhao — the Honorary Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments with Concurrent Regular Appointment Maozong — was to marry Princess Yizhang, and Maozong was then in mourning for his mother, an edict ordered his recall from mourning as Cloud Banner General to complete the marriage.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, because the younger brother of the former military commissioner of Hezhong, Zhang Maozhao — the Honorary Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments with Concurrent Regular Appointment Maozong — was to marry Princess Yizhang, and Maozong was then in mourning for his mother, an edict ordered his recall from mourning as Cloud Banner General to complete the marriage.

sentences.zh: 詔下，乂上疏諫曰：「墨缞之禮，本緣金革。

translations.literal: When the edict was issued, Yi submitted a memorial remonstrating: "The ritual of ink mourning garments originally arose from metal and leather warfare.
translations.idiomatic: When the edict was issued, Yi submitted a memorial remonstrating: "The ritual of ink mourning garments originally arose from metal and leather warfare.

sentences.zh: 從古已來，未有駙馬起復尚主者。

translations.literal: From antiquity to the present, there has never been an imperial son-in-law recalled from mourning to marry a princess.
translations.idiomatic: From antiquity to the present, there has never been an imperial son-in-law recalled from mourning to marry a princess.

sentences.zh: 既乖典禮，且違人情，切恐不可。」

translations.literal: It both violates canonical ritual and goes against human feeling; I deeply fear it cannot be done."
translations.idiomatic: It both violates canonical ritual and goes against human feeling; I deeply fear it cannot be done."

sentences.zh: 上令中使宣諭云：「茂宗母臨亡有請，重違其心。」

translations.literal: The emperor ordered a palace envoy to proclaim: "Maozong's mother on her deathbed made a request; to heavily violate her heart would be wrong."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered a palace envoy to proclaim: "Maozong's mother on her deathbed made a request; to heavily violate her heart would be wrong."

sentences.zh: 乂又拜疏，辭逾激切。

translations.literal: Yi again submitted a memorial bowing, his words increasingly forceful.
translations.idiomatic: Yi again submitted a memorial bowing, his words increasingly forceful.

sentences.zh: 德宗於延英特召入對，上曰：「卿所言，古禮也。

translations.literal: Dezong specially summoned him for audience in the Yanying Hall; the emperor said: "What you speak is ancient ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong specially summoned him for audience in the Yanying Hall; the emperor said: "What you speak is ancient ritual.

sentences.zh: 朕聞如今人家，往往有借吉為婚嫁者，卿何苦固執？」

translations.literal: I hear that in households nowadays people often borrow auspicious days for marriage — why must you be so stubborn?"
translations.idiomatic: I hear that in households nowadays people often borrow auspicious days for marriage — why must you be so stubborn?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「臣聞裏俗有不甚知禮法者，或女居父母服內，家既貧匱，旁無至親，即有借吉以就禮者。

translations.literal: He replied: "I hear that in village custom there are those not very knowing in ritual law: sometimes a daughter is within mourning for her parents, the family is poor and destitute, and with no close kin nearby, there are those who borrow auspicious days to complete the rites.
translations.idiomatic: He replied: "I hear that in village custom there are those not very knowing in ritual law: sometimes a daughter is within mourning for her parents, the family is poor and destitute, and with no close kin nearby, there are those who borrow auspicious days to complete the rites.

sentences.zh: 男子借吉而娶，臣未嘗聞之。

translations.literal: A man borrowing auspicious days to marry — I have never heard of it.
translations.idiomatic: A man borrowing auspicious days to marry — I have never heard of it.

sentences.zh: 況陛下臨禦已來，每事憲章典禮。

translations.literal: Moreover, since Your Majesty has held the throne, in every matter you have upheld canonical ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, since Your Majesty has held the throne, in every matter you have upheld canonical ritual.

sentences.zh: 建中年郡縣主出降，皆詔有司依禮，不用俗儀，天下慶戴。

translations.literal: In the Jianzhong era when commandery and county princesses married down, edicts all ordered the responsible offices to follow ritual and not use vulgar ceremonies; the realm rejoiced and revered this.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jianzhong era when commandery and county princesses married down, edicts all ordered the responsible offices to follow ritual and not use vulgar ceremonies; the realm rejoiced and revered this.

sentences.zh: 忽今駙馬起復成禮，實恐驚駭物聽。

translations.literal: Suddenly now having the imperial son-in-law recalled from mourning to complete marriage truly fears it will startle and alarm all who hear.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly now having the imperial son-in-law recalled from mourning to complete marriage truly fears it will startle and alarm all who hear.

sentences.zh: 臣或聞公主年甚幼小，即更俟一年出降，時既未失，且合禮經，實天下幸甚！」

translations.literal: I have also heard the princess is very young; if she waits one more year to marry down, the time will not yet be lost and it will accord with ritual canon — it would truly be the realm's great fortune!"
translations.idiomatic: I have also heard the princess is very young; if she waits one more year to marry down, the time will not yet be lost and it will accord with ritual canon — it would truly be the realm's great fortune!"

sentences.zh: 上曰：「卿言甚善，更俟商量。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Your words are very good; we will wait further for deliberation."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Your words are very good; we will wait further for deliberation."

sentences.zh: 俄而韋彤、裴堪諫疏繼入，上不悅，促令奉行前詔，然上心頗重乂。

translations.literal: Soon memorials of remonstrance from Wei Tong and Pei Kan followed; the emperor was displeased and urgently ordered the previous edict carried out, yet in his heart he greatly valued Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon memorials of remonstrance from Wei Tong and Pei Kan followed; the emperor was displeased and urgently ordered the previous edict carried out, yet in his heart he greatly valued Yi.

sentences.zh: 上嘗登淩煙閣，見左壁頹剝，文字殘缺，每行僅有三五字，命錄之以問宰臣。

translations.literal: The emperor once ascended Lingyan Pavilion and saw the left wall peeling and decayed, the characters incomplete — each line had only three or five characters; he ordered them copied and used to question the chancellors.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once ascended Lingyan Pavilion and saw the left wall peeling and decayed, the characters incomplete — each line had only three or five characters; he ordered them copied and used to question the chancellors.

sentences.zh: 宰臣遽受宣，無以對；

translations.literal: The chancellors hastily received the command and had nothing with which to reply;
translations.idiomatic: The chancellors hastily received the command and had nothing with which to reply;

sentences.zh: 即令召乂至，對曰：「此聖歷中《侍臣圖贊》，臣皆記憶。」

translations.literal: they then ordered Yi summoned, and he replied: "This is the 'Portraits and Encomia of Attending Ministers' from the Shengli era; I remember them all."
translations.idiomatic: they then ordered Yi summoned, and he replied: "This is the 'Portraits and Encomia of Attending Ministers' from the Shengli era; I remember them all."

sentences.zh: 即於御前口誦，以補其缺，不失一字。

translations.literal: He then recited before the throne from memory to fill the gaps, not missing a single character.
translations.idiomatic: He then recited before the throne from memory to fill the gaps, not missing a single character.

sentences.zh: 上嘆曰：「虞世南暗寫《列女傳》，無以加也。」

translations.literal: The emperor sighed: "Yu Shinan copied the 'Biographies of Exemplary Women' from memory in the dark — this cannot surpass it."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sighed: "Yu Shinan copied the 'Biographies of Exemplary Women' from memory in the dark — this cannot surpass it."

sentences.zh: 十八年，遷起居舍人，轉司勛員外郎，皆兼史職。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was transferred to Master of Ceremonial for the Emperor's Movements and then to Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel, all while concurrently holding historiographical office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was transferred to Master of Ceremonial for the Emperor's Movements and then to Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel, all while concurrently holding historiographical office.

sentences.zh: 時集賢學士甚眾，會詔問神策軍建置之由。

translations.literal: At the time the Hall of Assembled Worthies had very many academicians; an edict then asked the origin of the establishment of the Divine Strategy Army.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Hall of Assembled Worthies had very many academicians; an edict then asked the origin of the establishment of the Divine Strategy Army.

sentences.zh: 相府討求，不知所出，諸學士悉不能對，乃訪於乂。

translations.literal: The chancellery sought it but did not know where it came from; all the academicians could not answer, and they then consulted Yi.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellery sought it but did not know where it came from; all the academicians could not answer, and they then consulted Yi.

sentences.zh: 乂征引根源，事甚詳悉，宰臣高郢、鄭珣瑜相對曰：「集賢有人矣！」

translations.literal: Yi cited origins and sources; the matter was very detailed; chancellors Gao Ying and Zheng Xunyu said to each other: "The Hall of Assembled Worthies has its man!"
translations.idiomatic: Yi cited origins and sources; the matter was very detailed; chancellors Gao Ying and Zheng Xunyu said to each other: "The Hall of Assembled Worthies has its man!"

sentences.zh: 翌日，詔兼判集賢院事。

translations.literal: The next day an edict ordered him to serve concurrently as acting director of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: The next day an edict ordered him to serve concurrently as acting director of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 父子代為學士，儒者榮之。

translations.literal: Father and son served as academicians in succession; Confucian scholars took it as an honor.
translations.idiomatic: Father and son served as academicians in succession; Confucian scholars took it as an honor.

sentences.zh: 時順宗祔廟，將行祧遷之禮，詔公卿議。

translations.literal: At the time Shunzong was to be enshrined in the ancestral temple; the rite of removing a distant ancestor was to be performed; an edict ordered the high ministers to discuss it.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Shunzong was to be enshrined in the ancestral temple; the rite of removing a distant ancestor was to be performed; an edict ordered the high ministers to discuss it.

sentences.zh: 咸云：「中宗中興之主，不當遷。」

translations.literal: All said: "Zhongzong was a restoration sovereign; he should not be removed."
translations.idiomatic: All said: "Zhongzong was a restoration sovereign; he should not be removed."

sentences.zh: 乂建議云：「中宗既正位柩前，乃受母後篡奪，五王翼戴，方復大業。

translations.literal: Yi proposed: "Zhongzong, having already taken the throne before the coffin, then received the usurpation of his mother the empress dowager; the Five Princes supported and raised him, and only then did he restore the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Yi proposed: "Zhongzong, having already taken the throne before the coffin, then received the usurpation of his mother the empress dowager; the Five Princes supported and raised him, and only then did he restore the great enterprise.

sentences.zh: 此乃由我失之，因人得之，止可同於返正，不得號為中興。」

translations.literal: This was a case of losing it through ourselves and gaining it through others; he may only be classed with returning to legitimacy and may not be styled a restoration."
translations.idiomatic: This was a case of losing it through ourselves and gaining it through others; he may only be classed with returning to legitimacy and may not be styled a restoration."

sentences.zh: 群議紛然，竟依乂所執。

translations.literal: The assembled discussion was contentious; in the end they followed what Yi held.
translations.idiomatic: The assembled discussion was contentious; in the end they followed what Yi held.

sentences.zh: 元和二年，遷兵部郎中。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanhe he was transferred to Director in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yuanhe he was transferred to Director in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 與許孟容、韋貫之等受詔刪定制敕，成三十卷，奏行用。

translations.literal: Together with Xu Mengrong, Wei Guanzhi, and others he received an edict to revise and fix regulations and edicts; thirty juan were completed, submitted, and put into use.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Xu Mengrong, Wei Guanzhi, and others he received an edict to revise and fix regulations and edicts; thirty juan were completed, submitted, and put into use.

sentences.zh: 改秘書少監，復兼史館修撰。

translations.literal: He was reassigned as Vice Director of the Palace Library and again served concurrently as historiographer in the History Institute.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as Vice Director of the Palace Library and again served concurrently as historiographer in the History Institute.

sentences.zh: 尋奉詔與獨孤郁、韋處厚同修《德宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Soon he received an edict together with Dugu Yu and Wei Chuhou to revise the Veritable Records of Dezong.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he received an edict together with Dugu Yu and Wei Chuhou to revise the Veritable Records of Dezong.

sentences.zh: 五年，書成奏禦，以功拜右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the book was completed and submitted to the throne; for this service he was appointed Right Remonstrance Official.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the book was completed and submitted to the throne; for this service he was appointed Right Remonstrance Official.

sentences.zh: 明年監修國史裴垍罷相，李吉甫再入，以乂垍之修撰，改授太常少卿。

translations.literal: The next year Pei Ji, supervising editor of the national history, was removed as chancellor; Li Jifu entered again; because Yi was Ji's compiler, he was reassigned as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Pei Ji, supervising editor of the national history, was removed as chancellor; Li Jifu entered again; because Yi was Ji's compiler, he was reassigned as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 久之，遷秘書監。

translations.literal: After a long time he was transferred to Director of the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was transferred to Director of the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 乂性樸直，不能事人，或遇權臣專政，輒數歲不遷官。

translations.literal: Yi's nature was plain and upright; he could not serve men; when he encountered powerful ministers monopolizing government, he would go several years without transfer.
translations.idiomatic: Yi's nature was plain and upright; he could not serve men; when he encountered powerful ministers monopolizing government, he would go several years without transfer.

sentences.zh: 在朝垂三十年，前後每有大政事、大議論，宰執不能裁決者，必召以咨訪。

translations.literal: In court for nearly thirty years, whenever there were great state affairs or great debates that the chancellors could not decide, he was always summoned for consultation.
translations.idiomatic: In court for nearly thirty years, whenever there were great state affairs or great debates that the chancellors could not decide, he was always summoned for consultation.

sentences.zh: 乂征引典故，以參時事，多合其宜，然亦以此自滯。

translations.literal: Yi cited canonical precedents to compare with current affairs; mostly they fit what was fitting, yet he also on this account stagnated himself.
translations.idiomatic: Yi cited canonical precedents to compare with current affairs; mostly they fit what was fitting, yet he also on this account stagnated himself.

sentences.zh: 而好學不倦，老而彌篤，雖甚寒暑，手不釋卷。

translations.literal: Yet he loved learning without tiring; in old age he became only more earnest; even in extreme cold and heat his hand did not release his scroll.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he loved learning without tiring; in old age he became only more earnest; even in extreme cold and heat his hand did not release his scroll.

sentences.zh: 旁通百家，尤精歷代沿革。

translations.literal: He broadly mastered the hundred schools and was especially expert in the changes of successive dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: He broadly mastered the hundred schools and was especially expert in the changes of successive dynasties.

sentences.zh: 家藏書一萬五千卷。

translations.literal: His household collection held fifteen thousand juan of books.
translations.idiomatic: His household collection held fifteen thousand juan of books.

sentences.zh: 本名武，因憲宗召對，奏曰，「陛下已誅群寇，偃武修文，臣名於義未允，請改名乂。」

translations.literal: His original name was Wu; because Xianzong summoned him for audience, in memorial he stated: "Your Majesty has already executed the bandit rebels and is now laying down arms to cultivate culture — my name no longer suits the meaning; I request to change it to Yi."
translations.idiomatic: His original name was Wu; because Xianzong summoned him for audience, in memorial he stated: "Your Majesty has already executed the bandit rebels and is now laying down arms to cultivate culture — my name no longer suits the meaning; I request to change it to Yi."

sentences.zh: 上忻然從之。

translations.literal: The emperor gladly assented.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor gladly assented.

sentences.zh: 時帝方用兵兩河，乂亦因此諷諭耳。

translations.literal: At the time the emperor was just then using troops on the two He regions; Yi also on this account offered indirect counsel.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the emperor was just then using troops on the two He regions; Yi also on this account offered indirect counsel.

sentences.zh: 乂居史任二十年，所著《大唐宰輔錄》七十卷、《淩煙閣功臣》、《秦府十八學士》、《史臣》等傳四十卷。

translations.literal: Yi held historiographical office for twenty years; works he authored include the "Record of Tang Chancellors" in seventy juan, biographies of the Lingyan Pavilion meritorious ministers, the eighteen scholars of the Prince of Qin's household, and historiographers — forty juan in all.
translations.idiomatic: Yi held historiographical office for twenty years; works he authored include the "Record of Tang Chancellors" in seventy juan, biographies of the Lingyan Pavilion meritorious ministers, the eighteen scholars of the Prince of Qin's household, and historiographers — forty juan in all.

sentences.zh: 長慶元年卒，年七十五，贈禮部尚書，謚曰懿。

translations.literal: He died in the first year of Changqing, aged seventy-five; he was posthumously awarded Minister of Rites and given the posthumous title Yi.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the first year of Changqing at the age of seventy-five; he was posthumously awarded Minister of Rites and given the posthumous title Yi.

sentences.zh: 子係、伸、偕、仙、佶。

translations.literal: His sons were Xi, Shen, Xie, Xian, and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Xi, Shen, Xie, Xian, and Ji.

sentences.zh: 係，太和初授昭應尉，直史館。

translations.literal: Xi, in the early Taihe era, was appointed bailiff of Zhaoying and served directly in the History Institute.
translations.idiomatic: Xi, in the early Taihe era, was appointed bailiff of Zhaoying and served directly in the History Institute.

sentences.zh: 二年，拜右拾遺、史館修撰，典實有父風。

translations.literal: In the second year he was appointed Right Remonstrance Official and historiographer in the History Institute; in handling substance he had his father's manner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was appointed Right Remonstrance Official and historiographer in the History Institute; in handling substance he had his father's manner.

sentences.zh: 與同職沈傳師、鄭浣、陳夷行、李漢等受詔撰《憲宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Together with colleagues Shen Chuanshi, Zheng Huan, Chen Yixing, and Li Han he received an edict to compile the Veritable Records of Xianzong.
translations.idiomatic: Together with colleagues Shen Chuanshi, Zheng Huan, Chen Yixing, and Li Han he received an edict to compile the Veritable Records of Xianzong.

sentences.zh: 四年，書成奏禦，轉尚書工部員外，遷本司郎中，仍兼史職。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the book was completed and submitted to the throne; he was transferred to Vice Director in the Ministry of Public Works in the Ministry of Works, then to Director in his home ministry, still concurrently holding historiographical office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the book was completed and submitted to the throne; he was transferred to Vice Director in the Ministry of Public Works in the Ministry of Works, then to Director in his home ministry, still concurrently holding historiographical office.

sentences.zh: 宰相宋申錫為北軍羅織，罪在不測，係與諫官崔玄亮泣諫於玉階之下，申錫亦減死，時論稱之。

translations.literal: When Chancellor Song Shenxi was framed by the Northern Armies and his guilt was uncertain, Xi together with remonstrance officials Cui Xuanliang wept and remonstrated below the jade steps; Shenxi also had his death sentence reduced, and public opinion praised this.
translations.idiomatic: When Chancellor Song Shenxi was framed by the Northern Armies and his guilt was uncertain, Xi together with remonstrance officials Cui Xuanliang wept and remonstrated below the jade steps; Shenxi also had his death sentence reduced, and public opinion praised this.

sentences.zh: 開成中，轉諫議大夫。

translations.literal: In the Kaicheng era he was transferred to Remonstrance Official.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kaicheng era he was transferred to Remonstrance Official.

sentences.zh: 武宗朝，李德裕用事，惡李漢，以係與漢僚婿，出為桂管都護禦觀察使。

translations.literal: In the Wuzong era Li Deyu held power and hated Li Han; because Xi was son-in-law to Han's colleague, he was sent out as Military Commissioner, Surveillance Commissioner, and Defense Commissioner of Guiguan.
translations.idiomatic: In the Wuzong era Li Deyu held power and hated Li Han; because Xi was son-in-law to Han's colleague, he was sent out as Military Commissioner, Surveillance Commissioner, and Defense Commissioner of Guiguan.

sentences.zh: 中宗即位，征拜給事中、集賢殿學士、判院事。

translations.literal: When Zhongzong took the throne, he was summoned and appointed Supervising Secretary, academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and acting director of the institute.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhongzong took the throne, he was summoned and appointed Supervising Secretary, academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and acting director of the institute.

sentences.zh: 轉吏部侍郎，改左丞。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel and reassigned as Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel and reassigned as Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 出為興元節度使，入為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: He went out as military commissioner of Xingyuan and entered as Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as military commissioner of Xingyuan and entered as Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 俄檢校戶部尚書、鳳翔尹，充鳳翔隴節度使，入為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon he was made Acting Minister of Revenue, Intendant of Fengxiang, and Military Commissioner of Fengxiang and Long, and entered as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made Acting Minister of Revenue, Intendant of Fengxiang, and Military Commissioner of Fengxiang and Long, and entered as Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 以弟伸為丞相，懇辭朝秩，檢校尚書左僕射、襄州刺史、山南東道節度使，封淮陽縣開國公，食邑五百戶。

translations.literal: Because his younger brother Shen became chancellor, he earnestly declined court rank and was made Acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Prefect of Xiang Prefecture, and Military Commissioner of Shannan East Circuit, enfeoffed as Duke of Huaiyang County with a fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Because his younger brother Shen became chancellor, he earnestly declined court rank and was made Acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Prefect of Xiang Prefecture, and Military Commissioner of Shannan East Circuit, enfeoffed as Duke of Huaiyang County with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 伸，登進士第，歷佐使府。

translations.literal: Shen passed the jinshi examination and successively served as staff officer in commissioner offices.
translations.idiomatic: Shen passed the jinshi examination and successively served as staff officer in commissioner offices.

sentences.zh: 大中初入朝，右補闕、史館修撰，轉中書舍人，召入翰林為學士。

translations.literal: In the early Dazhong era he entered court as Right Supplementation Official and historiographer in the History Institute, was transferred to Secretariat Drafter, and was summoned into the Hanlin Academy as academician.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Dazhong era he entered court as Right Supplementation Official and historiographer in the History Institute, was transferred to Secretariat Drafter, and was summoned into the Hanlin Academy as academician.

sentences.zh: 自員外郎中，至戶部侍郎、學士承旨，轉兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: From vice director and director he rose to Vice Minister of Revenue and chief academician, then was transferred to Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: From vice director and director he rose to Vice Minister of Revenue and chief academician, then was transferred to Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 大中末，中書侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: At the end of Dazhong he was Vice Director of the Secretariat and Associate Councilor of State.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Dazhong he was Vice Director of the Secretariat and Associate Councilor of State.

sentences.zh: 仙、佶，皆至刺史。

translations.literal: Xian and Ji both rose to prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Xian and Ji both rose to prefect.

sentences.zh: 偕，有史才，以父任歷官左拾遺、史館修撰，轉補闕。

translations.literal: Xie had talent for history; through his father's office he successively served as Left Remonstrance Official and historiographer in the History Institute, and was transferred to Supplementation Official.
translations.idiomatic: Xie had talent for history; through his father's office he successively served as Left Remonstrance Official and historiographer in the History Institute, and was transferred to Supplementation Official.

sentences.zh: 咸通中，與同職盧耽、牛叢等受詔修《文宗實錄》。

translations.literal: In the Xiantong era he together with colleagues Lu Dan and Niu Cong received an edict to revise the Veritable Records of Wenzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xiantong era he together with colleagues Lu Dan and Niu Cong received an edict to revise the Veritable Records of Wenzong.

sentences.zh: 蔣氏世以儒史稱，不以文藻為事，唯伸及系子兆有文才，登進士第，然不為文士所譽。

translations.literal: The Jiang clan for generations was famed for Confucian learning and historiography and did not make literary ornament their business; only Shen and Xi's son Zhao had literary talent and passed the jinshi examination, yet they were not praised by literary men.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiang clan for generations was famed for Confucian learning and historiography and did not make literary ornament their business; only Shen and Xi's son Zhao had literary talent and passed the jinshi examination, yet they were not praised by literary men.

sentences.zh: 與柳氏、沈氏父子相繼修國史實錄，時推良史，京師云《蔣氏日曆》，士族靡不家藏焉。

translations.literal: Together with the Liu and Shen families, father and son successively revised the national history and veritable records; they were acclaimed as fine historians. In the capital people called it the Chiang Family Calendar, and no gentry household failed to keep a copy at home.
translations.idiomatic: Along with the Liu and Shen families, father and son in succession edited the national history and veritable records; contemporaries hailed them as exemplary historians. In the capital the work was known as the Chiang Family Calendar, and every gentry household kept a copy.

sentences.zh: 柳登

translations.literal: Liu Deng
translations.idiomatic: Liu Deng

sentences.zh: 柳登，字成伯，河東人。

translations.literal: Liu Deng, styled Chengbi, was a man of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Deng, styled Chengbi, was from Hedong.

sentences.zh: 父芳，肅宗朝史官，與同職韋述受詔添修吳兢所撰《國史》；

translations.literal: His father Fang was a historiographer in the Suzong reign and, together with his colleague Wei Shu, received orders to supplement and revise the National History compiled by Wu Jing;
translations.idiomatic: His father Fang served as a historiographer under Emperor Suzong and, with his colleague Wei Shu, was ordered to supplement and revise Wu Jing's National History;

sentences.zh: 殺青未竟而述亡，芳緒述凡例，勒成《國史》一百三十卷。

translations.literal: before the final editing was finished Wei Shu died; Fang took up Shu's outline and compiled the National History in one hundred thirty scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: before the final editing was complete Wei Shu died; Fang followed Shu's outline and completed the National History in one hundred thirty scrolls.

sentences.zh: 上自高祖，下止乾元，而敘天寶後事，絕無倫類，取舍非工，不為史氏所稱。

translations.literal: It ran from Gaozu down to the Qianyuan era, but in narrating events after the Tianbao period there was absolutely no order or category, and the selections were poorly made; historians did not praise it.
translations.idiomatic: It covered the reign from Gaozu down to the Qianyuan era, but its account of events after the Tianbao period lacked all order and proportion, and its editorial choices were poor; historians did not commend it.

sentences.zh: 然芳勤於記註，含毫罔倦。

translations.literal: Yet Fang was diligent in recording and annotation, never weary though the brush was in his hand.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Fang was tireless in recording and annotating, never wearying at his desk.

sentences.zh: 屬安、史亂離，國史散落，編綴所聞，率多闕漏。

translations.literal: When the An and Shi rebellions brought chaos and separation, the national history was scattered and lost; what he compiled from hearsay was mostly incomplete.
translations.idiomatic: During the An and Shi rebellions the national history was scattered and lost, and what he pieced together from hearsay was largely incomplete.

sentences.zh: 上元中坐事徙黔中，遇內官高力士亦貶巫州，遇諸途。

translations.literal: In the Shangyuan era he was punished and banished to Qianzhong; he encountered the inner-palace eunuch Gao Lishi, also demoted to Wuzhou, on the road.
translations.idiomatic: In the Shangyuan era he was punished and exiled to Qianzhong; on the road he met the inner-palace eunuch Gao Lishi, likewise demoted to Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 芳以所疑禁中事，咨於力士。

translations.literal: Fang consulted Lishi about matters within the forbidden palace that puzzled him.
translations.idiomatic: Fang asked Lishi about matters of the inner palace that puzzled him.

sentences.zh: 力士說開元、天寶中時政事，芳隨口誌之。

translations.literal: Lishi recounted the politics of the Kaiyuan and Tianbao eras, and Fang recorded his words as he spoke.
translations.idiomatic: Lishi recounted political affairs of the Kaiyuan and Tianbao eras, and Fang recorded them as he spoke.

sentences.zh: 又以《國史》已成，經於奏禦，不可復改，乃別撰《唐歷》四十卷，以力士所傳，載於年歷之下。

translations.literal: Because the National History was already complete and had been presented to the throne, it could not be revised again; he therefore separately compiled the Tang Annals in forty scrolls, placing what Lishi had transmitted beneath the yearly chronology.
translations.idiomatic: Since the National History was already complete and had been presented to the throne, it could not be revised; he therefore separately compiled the Tang Annals in forty scrolls, recording Lishi's account under the yearly entries.

sentences.zh: 芳自永寧尉、直史館，轉拾遺、補闕、員外郎，皆居史任，位終右司郎中、集賢學士。

translations.literal: Fang rose from aide of Yongning, direct appointment to the Historiography Institute, to remonstrance and reviser and external official—all historiographical posts—and ended as Right Director in the Ministry of Revenue and Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Fang rose from aide of Yongning and direct appointment to the Historiography Institute through remonstrance and reviser and external official—all historiographical posts—and ended as Right Director in the Ministry of Revenue and Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 登少嗜學，與弟冕鹹以該博著稱。

translations.literal: Deng from youth loved learning; he and his younger brother Mian were both famed for comprehensive erudition.
translations.idiomatic: Deng loved learning from youth; he and his younger brother Mian were both renowned for encyclopedic learning.

sentences.zh: 登年六十餘，方從宦遊，累遷至膳部郎中。

translations.literal: Deng was over sixty before he entered official service on the circuit; he was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Deng was over sixty before he took up office on the circuit; he rose through repeated promotions to Director in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 元和初，為大理少卿，與刑部侍郎許孟容等七人，奉詔刪定開元已後敕格。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yuanhe reign he served as Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review and, with Vice Minister of Justice Xu Mengrong and six others, received orders to abridge and fix the statutes and regulations issued after Kaiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Yuanhe he served as Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review and, with Vice Minister of Justice Xu Mengrong and six others, was ordered to abridge and codify statutes and regulations issued after Kaiyuan.

sentences.zh: 再遷右庶子，以衰病改秘書監，不拜，授右散騎常侍致仕。

translations.literal: He was promoted again to Right Vice Director of the Crown Prince's Household; because of age and illness he was transferred to Director of the Palace Library, did not accept the appointment, and was granted the post of Right Regular Palace Attendant with retirement.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted again to Right Vice Director of the Crown Prince's Household, he declined transfer to Director of the Palace Library on account of age and illness and was granted retirement as Right Regular Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 長慶二年卒，時九十餘，輟朝一日，贈工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the second year of Changqing he died, aged over ninety; the court suspended audiences for one day and posthumously honored him as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second year of Changqing, aged over ninety; the court suspended audiences for one day and posthumously honored him as Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 弟冕。

translations.literal: His younger brother Mian.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother was Mian.

sentences.zh: 冕，文史兼該，長於吏職。

translations.literal: Mian was versed in both letters and history and excelled in administrative duties.
translations.idiomatic: Mian was accomplished in both letters and history and excelled in administrative affairs.

sentences.zh: 貞元初，為太常博士。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhenyuan reign he served as Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Zhenyuan he served as Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 二年，昭德王皇后之喪，論皇太子服紀。

translations.literal: In the second year, at the mourning for Empress Zhaode, the period of mourning dress for the crown prince was debated.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, at the mourning for Empress Zhaode, the question arose of what mourning the crown prince should wear.

sentences.zh: 左補闕穆質請依禮周期而除，冕與同職張薦等奏議曰：

translations.literal: Left Reviser Mu Zhi requested following the ritual period for removal of mourning; Mian together with Zhang Jian and others of the same office submitted a memorial stating:
translations.idiomatic: Left Reviser Mu Zhi asked that mourning be removed after the ritual period; Mian, together with Zhang Jian and others of the same office, submitted a memorial stating:

sentences.zh: 準《開元禮》，子為母齊衰三年，此王公已下服紀。

translations.literal: According to the Kaiyuan Rites, a son wears unhemmed sackcloth for his mother for three years—this is the mourning dress for kings and dukes downward.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Kaiyuan Rites, a son wears unhemmed sackcloth mourning for his mother for three years—this is the mourning prescribed for kings and dukes downward.

sentences.zh: 皇太子為皇后喪服，國禮無聞。

translations.literal: The state rites are silent on mourning dress for the crown prince at an empress's funeral.
translations.idiomatic: The state rites say nothing about mourning dress for the crown prince at an empress's funeral.

sentences.zh: 昔晉武帝元皇后崩，其時亦疑太子所服。

translations.literal: In former times, when Empress Yuan of Emperor Wu of Jin died, there was likewise doubt about what the crown prince should wear.
translations.idiomatic: In former times, when Empress Yuan of Emperor Wu of Jin died, there was likewise doubt about the crown prince's mourning dress.

sentences.zh: 杜元凱奏議曰：「古者天子三年之喪，既葬除服。

translations.literal: Du Yuankai submitted a memorial stating: "In antiquity the Son of Heaven observed three years of mourning and removed mourning garments after the burial.
translations.idiomatic: Du Yuankai submitted a memorial stating, "In antiquity the Son of Heaven observed three years of mourning and removed mourning garments after the burial.

sentences.zh: 魏氏革命，亦以既葬為節。

translations.literal: When Wei transformed the mandate, it likewise took burial as the limit.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei transformed the mandate, it likewise took burial as the limit.

sentences.zh: 故天子諸侯之禮，嘗已具矣，惡其害己而削去其節。

translations.literal: Thus the rites for Son of Heaven and feudal lords had once been fully established, but they hated the burden on themselves and cut away the limits.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the rites for Son of Heaven and feudal lords had once been fully established, but rulers hated the burden on themselves and cut away the limits.

sentences.zh: 今其存者唯《士喪禮》一篇，戴勝之記錯雜其內，亦難以取正。

translations.literal: What survives now is only the one scroll of Rites of the Scholar's Mourning, with Dai Sheng's records jumbled within it, and it is hard to take as authoritative.
translations.idiomatic: What survives now is only the one scroll of Rites of the Scholar's Mourning, with Dai Sheng's records jumbled within it, and it is hard to take as authoritative.

sentences.zh: 皇太子配二尊，與國為體，固宜卒哭而除服。」

translations.literal: The crown prince is paired with two exalted persons and is one body with the state; he should indeed end wailing and remove mourning dress."
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince is paired with two exalted persons and is one body with the state; he should indeed end wailing and remove mourning dress."

sentences.zh: 於是山濤、魏舒並同其議，晉朝從之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Shan Tao and Wei Shu both agreed with this opinion, and the Jin court followed it.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Shan Tao and Wei Shu both agreed, and the Jin court followed their view.

sentences.zh: 歷代遵行，垂之不朽。

translations.literal: Successive dynasties observed it, and it has endured without perishing.
translations.idiomatic: Successive dynasties observed it, and it has endured ever since.

sentences.zh: 臣謹按實錄，文德皇后以貞觀十年九月崩，十一月葬，至十一年正月，除晉王，治為并州都督。

translations.literal: Your subjects respectfully examine the veritable record: Empress Wende died in the ninth month of the tenth year of Zhenguan and was buried in the eleventh month; by the first month of the eleventh year Prince of Jin was released from mourning and appointed concurrently as Governor-General of Bing.
translations.idiomatic: Your subjects respectfully examine the veritable record: Empress Wende died in the ninth month of the tenth year of Zhenguan and was buried in the eleventh month; by the first month of the eleventh year the Prince of Jin was released from mourning and appointed concurrently as Governor-General of Bing.

sentences.zh: 晉王即高宗在籓所封，文德皇后幼子，據其命官，當已除之義也。

translations.literal: The Prince of Jin was the title Gaozong held while in the fief; he was Empress Wende's youngest son, and judging from his appointment to office, he must already have been released from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Jin was the title Gaozong held in the fief; he was Empress Wende's youngest son, and from his appointment to office it is clear he had already been released from mourning.

sentences.zh: 今請皇太子依魏、晉故事，為大行皇后喪服，葬而虞，虞而卒哭，卒哭而除，心喪終制，庶存厭降之禮。

translations.literal: We now request that the crown prince follow the Wei and Jin precedents in mourning dress for the late empress: burial and then the offering rite, the offering rite and then the end of wailing, the end of wailing and then removal of dress, with inner mourning carried through the full period—thus preserving the rite of suppressed mourning.
translations.idiomatic: We now request that the crown prince follow Wei and Jin precedent in mourning for the late empress: burial, then the offering rite; the offering rite, then the end of wailing; the end of wailing, then removal of dress—with inner mourning carried through the full period, thus preserving the rite of suppressed mourning.

sentences.zh: 事下中書，宰臣召問禮官曰：「《語》云：『子食於有喪者之側，未嘗飽也。』

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the Secretariat; the chief ministers summoned the ritual officials and asked: "The Analects says, 'When the Master ate beside someone in mourning, he never ate his fill.'
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the Secretariat; the chief ministers summoned the ritual officials and asked, "The Analects says, 'When the Master ate beside someone in mourning, he never ate his fill.'

sentences.zh: 今豈可令皇太子衰服侍膳，至於既葬乎？

translations.literal: How can we now have the crown prince serve meals in sackcloth mourning until after the burial?
translations.idiomatic: How can we now have the crown prince serve meals in sackcloth mourning until after the burial?

sentences.zh: 準令，群臣齊衰，給假三十日即公除。

translations.literal: According to statute, when officials wear unhemmed sackcloth, they are granted thirty days' leave and then publicly released from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: According to statute, when officials wear unhemmed sackcloth, they are granted thirty days' leave and then publicly released from mourning.

sentences.zh: 約於此制，更審議之。」

translations.literal: Measured against this regulation, reconsider the matter."
translations.idiomatic: Measured against this regulation, reconsider the matter."

sentences.zh: 張薦曰：「請依宋、齊間皇后為父母服三十日公除例，為皇太子喪服之節。」

translations.literal: Zhang Jian said: "I request following the precedent of the Song and Qi, when the empress mourned her parents with thirty days of public mourning followed by removal of mourning dress, to set the periods of mourning dress for the crown prince."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jian said, "I ask that we follow the Song and Qi precedent, when the empress mourned her parents with thirty days of public mourning followed by removal of dress, to set the crown prince's mourning periods."

sentences.zh: 三十日公除詣於正內，則服墨慘，歸至本院，衰麻如故。

translations.literal: On the thirtieth day of public removal of mourning he would proceed to the inner court in dark mourning dress; on returning to his own residence he would wear sackcloth as before.
translations.idiomatic: On the thirtieth day of public removal he would proceed to the inner court in dark mourning dress; on returning to his own residence he would wear sackcloth as before.

sentences.zh: 穆質曰：「杜元凱既葬除服之論，不足為法。

translations.literal: Mu Zhi said: "Du Yuankai's argument for removing mourning dress after burial is not fit to serve as law.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Zhi said, "Du Yuankai's argument for removing mourning dress after burial is not fit to serve as law.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為遵三年之制則太重，從三十日之變太輕，唯行古之道，以周年為定。」

translations.literal: This subject believes that following the three-year system would be too heavy, while adopting the thirty-day variation would be too light; only by following the ancient way and fixing one year as the standard can it be settled."
translations.idiomatic: I believe that following the three-year system would be too heavy, while adopting the thirty-day variation would be too light; only by following the ancient way and fixing one year as the standard can it be settled."

sentences.zh: 詔宰臣與禮官定可否。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the chief ministers and ritual officials to determine what was acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the chief ministers and ritual officials to determine what was acceptable.

sentences.zh: 宰臣以穆質所奏問博士，冕對曰：「準《禮》，三年喪，無貴賤一也。

translations.literal: The chief ministers questioned the erudites on what Mu Zhi had submitted; Mian replied: "According to the Rites, three years of mourning make no distinction between noble and humble.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers questioned the erudites on Mu Zhi's submission; Mian replied, "According to the Rites, three years of mourning make no distinction between noble and humble.

sentences.zh: 豈有以父母貴賤而差降喪服之節乎？

translations.literal: How could mourning dress be graded according to whether one's parents were noble or humble?
translations.idiomatic: How could mourning dress be graded according to whether one's parents were noble or humble?

sentences.zh: 且《禮》有公門脫齊衰，《開元禮》皇后為父母服十三月，其稟朝旨，十三日而除；

translations.literal: Moreover the Rites provide for removing unhemmed sackcloth at the public gate; the Kaiyuan Rites prescribe thirteen months of mourning when the empress mourns her parents, and following court instruction mourning is removed on the thirteenth day;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Rites provide for removing unhemmed sackcloth at the public gate; the Kaiyuan Rites prescribe thirteen months of mourning when the empress mourns her parents, and following court instruction mourning is removed on the thirteenth day;

sentences.zh: 皇太子為外祖父母服五月，其從朝旨，則五日而除。

translations.literal: the crown prince wears five months of mourning for maternal grandparents, and following court instruction it is removed on the fifth day.
translations.idiomatic: the crown prince wears five months of mourning for maternal grandparents, and following court instruction it is removed on the fifth day.

sentences.zh: 所以然者，恐喪服侍奉，有傷至尊之意也。

translations.literal: The reason is fear that serving in mourning dress would wound the intent of the supreme person.
translations.idiomatic: The reason is fear that serving in mourning dress would wound the supreme person's sensibilities.

sentences.zh: 故從權制，昭著國章，公門脫衰，義亦在此，豈皆為金革乎？

translations.literal: Therefore expedient regulations were adopted, clearly set forth in state statutes; removing sackcloth at the public gate has its meaning here too—surely it is not all because of military exigency?
translations.idiomatic: Therefore expedient regulations were adopted and clearly set forth in state statutes; removing sackcloth at the public gate has its meaning here too—surely it is not all because of military exigency?

sentences.zh: 皇太子今若抑哀，公除墨慘朝覲，歸至本院，依舊衰麻，酌於變通，庶可傳繼。」

translations.literal: If the crown prince now suppresses grief, publicly removes mourning and attends court in dark dress, and on returning to his residence wears sackcloth as before, this balance of adaptation can be handed down."
translations.idiomatic: If the crown prince now suppresses grief, publicly removes mourning and attends court in dark dress, and on returning to his residence wears sackcloth as before, this balance of adaptation can be handed down."

sentences.zh: 宰臣然其議，遂命太常卿鄭叔則草奏，以冕議為是。

translations.literal: The chief ministers approved this opinion and ordered Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Zheng Shuzhe to draft the memorial, taking Mian's opinion as correct.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers approved this opinion and ordered Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Zheng Shuzhe to draft the memorial, taking Mian's opinion as correct.

sentences.zh: 而穆質堅執前義，請依古禮，不妨太子墨衰於內也。

translations.literal: But Mu Zhi firmly held to his earlier view and requested following the ancient rites, without preventing the crown prince from wearing dark mourning within.
translations.idiomatic: But Mu Zhi firmly held to his earlier view and asked to follow the ancient rites, without preventing the crown prince from wearing dark mourning within.

sentences.zh: 宰臣齊映、劉滋參酌群議，請依叔則之議，制從之。

translations.literal: Chief ministers Qi Ying and Liu Zi weighed the various opinions and requested following Shuzhe's opinion; the regulation was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: Chief ministers Qi Ying and Liu Zi weighed the various opinions and asked to follow Shuzhe's opinion; the regulation was adopted.

sentences.zh: 及董晉為太常卿，德宗謂之曰：「皇太子所行周服，非朕本意，有諫官橫論之。

translations.literal: When Dong Jin became Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Dezong told him: "The full-year mourning the crown prince is observing is not my original intent; remonstrance officials argued forcefully against it.
translations.idiomatic: When Dong Jin became Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Dezong told him, "The full-year mourning the crown prince is observing is not my original intent; remonstrance officials argued forcefully against it.

sentences.zh: 今熟計之，即禮官請依魏、晉故事，斯甚折衷。」

translations.literal: On mature consideration, following the ritual officials' request to observe the Wei and Jin precedents is a very balanced compromise."
translations.idiomatic: On mature consideration, following the ritual officials' request to observe Wei and Jin precedent is a very balanced compromise."

sentences.zh: 明年冬，上以太子久在喪，合至正月晦受吉服，欲以其年十一月釋衰麻，以及新正稱慶。

translations.literal: The next winter the emperor, because the crown prince had long been in mourning and should by the last day of the first month receive auspicious dress, wished to release sackcloth in the eleventh month of that year so that the new year could be celebrated.
translations.idiomatic: The next winter, because the crown prince had long been in mourning and should by the last day of the first month receive auspicious dress, the emperor wished to release sackcloth in the eleventh month so the new year could be celebrated.

sentences.zh: 有司皆論不可，乃止。

translations.literal: All the relevant offices argued it was impermissible, and the plan was abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: All the relevant offices argued it was impermissible, and the plan was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 六年十一月，上親行郊享。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the sixth year the emperor personally performed the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the sixth year the emperor personally performed the suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 上重慎祀典，每事依禮。

translations.literal: The emperor treated the sacrificial canon with great care and followed ritual in every matter.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor treated the sacrificial canon with great care and followed ritual in every detail.

sentences.zh: 時冕為吏部郎中，攝太常博士，與司封郎中徐岱、倉部郎中陸質、工部郎中張薦，皆攝禮官，同修郊祀儀註，以備顧問。

translations.literal: At that time Mian was Director in the Ministry of Appointments and acting Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; together with Director in the Ministry of Seals Xu Dai, Director in the Ministry of Revenue Lu Zhi, and Director in the Ministry of Works Zhang Jian—all acting ritual officials—he jointly revised the suburban sacrifice protocol to be ready for consultation.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Mian was Director in the Ministry of Appointments and acting Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; together with Director in the Ministry of Seals Xu Dai, Director in the Ministry of Revenue Lu Zhi, and Director in the Ministry of Works Zhang Jian—all acting ritual officials—he jointly revised the suburban sacrifice protocol for consultation.

sentences.zh: 初，詔以皇太子亞獻終獻，當受誓戒否，冕對曰：「準《開元禮》有之，然誓詞雲『不供其職，國有常刑』，今太子受誓，請改雲『各揚其職，肅奉常儀』。」

translations.literal: Initially an edict asked whether the crown prince, as secondary and final offerer, should receive the oath of abstinence; Mian replied: "The Kaiyuan Rites provide for it, yet the oath text says 'If one fails in his duty, the state has fixed punishments.' Now that the crown prince receives the oath, I request changing it to read 'Each shall perform his duty and reverently observe the regular rites.'"
translations.idiomatic: Initially an edict asked whether the crown prince, as secondary and final offerer, should receive the oath of abstinence; Mian replied, "The Kaiyuan Rites provide for it, yet the oath text says, 'If one fails in his duty, the state has fixed punishments.' Since the crown prince receives the oath, I request changing it to read, 'Each shall perform his duty and reverently observe the regular rites.'"

sentences.zh: 上又問升郊廟去劍履，及象劍尺寸之度，祝文輕重之宜，冕據禮經沿革聞奏，上甚嘉之。

translations.literal: The emperor also asked about removing sword and shoes on ascending to the suburban altar and temple, the dimensions of ceremonial swords, and the proper weight of prayer texts; Mian reported according to the changes and continuities in the ritual classics, and the emperor greatly praised him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also asked about removing sword and shoes on ascending to the suburban altar and temple, the dimensions of ceremonial swords, and the proper weight of prayer texts; Mian reported according to the changes and continuities in the ritual classics, and the emperor greatly praised him.

sentences.zh: 冕言事頗切，執政不便之，出為婺州刺史。

translations.literal: Mian's statements on affairs were quite pointed; the chief ministers found them inconvenient and sent him out as prefect of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Mian's statements on affairs were quite pointed; the chief ministers found them inconvenient and sent him out as prefect of Wu.

sentences.zh: 十三年，兼御史中丞、福州刺史，充福建都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was concurrently Vice Censor-in-Chief and prefect of Fuzhou, serving as defense commissioner and circuit supervisor of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was concurrently Vice Censor-in-Chief and prefect of Fuzhou, serving as defense commissioner and circuit supervisor of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 冕在福州，奏置萬安監牧，於泉州界置群牧五，悉索部內馬五千七百匹、驢騾牛八百頭、羊三千口，以為監牧之資。

translations.literal: While in Fuzhou, Mian memorialized to establish the Wan'an supervisory pasture; within the bounds of Quanzhou he set up five group pastures, requisitioning throughout his jurisdiction five thousand seven hundred horses, eight hundred donkeys, mules, and cattle, and three thousand sheep as capital for the supervisory pasture.
translations.idiomatic: While in Fuzhou, Mian memorialized to establish the Wan'an supervisory pasture; within Quanzhou he set up five group pastures, requisitioning throughout his jurisdiction five thousand seven hundred horses, eight hundred donkeys, mules, and cattle, and three thousand sheep as capital for the pasture.

sentences.zh: 人情大擾，期年，無所滋息，詔罷之。

translations.literal: Popular sentiment was greatly disturbed; after a year there was no increase at all, and an edict abolished it.
translations.idiomatic: Popular sentiment was greatly disturbed; after a year there was no increase at all, and an edict abolished the project.

sentences.zh: 以政無狀，詔以閻濟美代歸而卒。

translations.literal: Because his governance was without merit, an edict replaced him with Yan Jimei; he returned and died on the way.
translations.idiomatic: Because his governance was without merit, an edict replaced him with Yan Jimei; he died on the return journey.

sentences.zh: 子璟，登進士第，亦以著述知名。

translations.literal: His son Jing passed the jinshi examination and was also known for literary composition.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jing passed the jinshi examination and was also known for literary composition.

sentences.zh: 璟，寶歷初登進士第，三遷監察御史。

translations.literal: Jing passed the jinshi examination at the beginning of the Baoli reign and was thrice promoted to Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Jing passed the jinshi examination at the opening of Baoli and was thrice promoted to Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 時郊廟告祭，差攝三公行事，多以雜品；

translations.literal: At that time when suburban and temple sacrifices were announced, the acting officials assigned to perform the rites as the Three Dukes were mostly men of mixed rank;
translations.idiomatic: At that time when suburban and temple sacrifices were announced, the acting officials assigned to perform the rites as the Three Dukes were mostly men of mixed rank;

sentences.zh: 璟時監察，奏曰：「準開元二十三年敕，宗廟大祠，宜差左右丞相、嗣王、特進、少保、少傅、尚書、賓客、御史大夫。

translations.literal: Jing, then an investigating censor, memorialized: "According to the edict of the twenty-third year of Kaiyuan, for great sacrifices at the ancestral temple the Left and Right Chancellors, heir apparent kings, specially advanced officials, Junior Guardian, Junior Mentor, ministers, guest of honor, and censor-in-chief should be assigned.
translations.idiomatic: Jing, then an investigating censor, memorialized, "According to the edict of the twenty-third year of Kaiyuan, for great sacrifices at the ancestral temple the Left and Right Chancellors, heir apparent kings, specially advanced officials, Junior Guardian, Junior Mentor, ministers, guest of honor, and censor-in-chief should be assigned.

sentences.zh: 又二十五年敕，太廟五享，差丞相、師傅、尚書、嗣、郡王通攝，餘司不在差限。

translations.literal: Again, the edict of the twenty-fifth year: for the five offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the chancellor, mentor, minister, heir, and commandery kings should serve in general substitution; other offices are outside the limit of assignment.
translations.idiomatic: Again, the edict of the twenty-fifth year: for the five offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the chancellor, mentor, minister, heir, and commandery kings should serve in general substitution; other offices are outside the limit of assignment.

sentences.zh: 又元和四年敕，太廟告祭攝官，太尉以宰相充，其攝司空、司徒，以僕射、尚書、師傅充，餘司不在差限。

translations.literal: Again, the edict of the fourth year of Yuanhe: for announced sacrifices at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the acting Grand Marshal is filled by the chancellor; acting Minister of Works and Minister of Education are filled by vice directors, ministers, and mentors; other offices are outside the limit of assignment.
translations.idiomatic: Again, the edict of the fourth year of Yuanhe: for announced sacrifices at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the acting Grand Marshal is filled by the chancellor; acting Minister of Works and Minister of Education are filled by vice directors, ministers, and mentors; other offices are outside the limit of assignment.

sentences.zh: 比來吏部因循，不守前後敕文，用人稍輕。

translations.literal: Recently the Ministry of Appointments has followed routine and not observed the earlier and later edicts; the men appointed have been somewhat light.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the Ministry of Appointments has followed routine and not observed the earlier and later edicts; the men appointed have been somewhat unworthy.

sentences.zh: 請自今年冬季，勒吏部準開元、元和敕例差官。」

translations.literal: I request that from this winter onward the Ministry of Appointments be ordered to assign officials according to the Kaiyuan and Yuanhe edict precedents."
translations.idiomatic: I request that from this winter onward the Ministry of Appointments be ordered to assign officials according to Kaiyuan and Yuanhe edict precedent."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was adopted.

sentences.zh: 再遷度支員外郎，轉吏部。

translations.literal: He was promoted again to External Official in the Ministry of Revenue and transferred to the Ministry of Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted again to External Official in the Ministry of Revenue and transferred to the Ministry of Appointments.

sentences.zh: 開成初，換庫部員外郎、知制誥，尋以本官充翰林學士。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaicheng he was transferred to External Official in the Ministry of Treasury and charged with drafting imperial documents; soon afterward he served in that office as Academician of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Kaicheng he was transferred to External Official in the Ministry of Treasury and charged with drafting imperial documents; soon afterward he served in that office as Academician of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 初，璟祖芳精於譜學，永泰中按宗正譜牒，自武德已來宗枝昭穆相承，撰皇室譜二十卷，號曰《永泰新譜》，自後無人修續。

translations.literal: Initially Jing's grandfather Fang was expert in genealogy; in the Yongtai era he examined the genealogical registers of the Court of the Imperial Clan, traced the imperial branches and generations from Wude onward, and compiled the Imperial Clan Genealogy in twenty scrolls, titled the New Yongtai Genealogy; afterward no one continued it.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Jing's grandfather Fang was expert in genealogy; in the Yongtai era he examined the genealogical registers of the Court of the Imperial Clan, traced the imperial branches and generations from Wude onward, and compiled the Imperial Clan Genealogy in twenty scrolls, titled the New Yongtai Genealogy; afterward no one continued it.

sentences.zh: 璟因召對，言及圖譜事，文宗曰：「卿祖嘗為皇家圖譜，朕昨觀之，甚為詳悉。

translations.literal: When Jing was summoned for audience and spoke of genealogical matters, Wenzong said: "Your grandfather once compiled the imperial genealogy; I read it yesterday and found it very detailed.
translations.idiomatic: When Jing was summoned for audience and spoke of genealogical matters, Wenzong said, "Your grandfather once compiled the imperial genealogy; I read it yesterday and found it very detailed.

sentences.zh: 卿檢永泰後試修續之。」

translations.literal: You are to examine events after Yongtai and try to continue it."
translations.idiomatic: Examine events after Yongtai and try to continue it."

sentences.zh: 璟依芳舊式，續德宗後事，成十卷，以附前譜，仍詔戶部供紙筆廚料。

translations.literal: Jing followed Fang's old format, continued events after Dezong, and completed ten scrolls to append to the earlier genealogy; an edict also ordered the Ministry of Revenue to supply paper, brushes, and pantry provisions.
translations.idiomatic: Jing followed Fang's old format, continued events after Dezong, and completed ten scrolls to append to the earlier genealogy; an edict also ordered the Ministry of Revenue to supply paper, brushes, and pantry provisions.

sentences.zh: 五年，拜中書舍人充職。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed Secretariat Drafter and continued in that office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed Secretariat Drafter and continued in that office.

sentences.zh: 武宗朝，轉禮部侍郎，再司貢籍，時號得人。

translations.literal: In the Wuzong reign he was transferred to Vice Minister of Rites and twice supervised the examination registry; at the time he was praised for selecting capable men.
translations.idiomatic: In the Wuzong reign he was transferred to Vice Minister of Rites and twice supervised the examination registry; at the time he was praised for selecting capable men.

sentences.zh: 子韜亦以進士擢第。

translations.literal: His son Tao also passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: His son Tao also passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 沈傳師

translations.literal: Shen Chuanshi
translations.idiomatic: Shen Chuanshi

sentences.zh: 沈傳師，字子言，吳人。

translations.literal: Shen Chuanshi, styled Ziyan, was a man of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Chuanshi, styled Ziyan, was from Wu.

sentences.zh: 父既濟，博通群籍，史筆尤工，吏部侍郎楊炎見而稱之。

translations.literal: His father Ji Ji was broadly versed in all books and especially skilled with the historiographer's brush; Vice Minister of Appointments Yang Yan saw him and praised him.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ji Ji was broadly versed in all books and especially skilled with the historiographer's brush; Vice Minister of Appointments Yang Yan saw him and praised him.

sentences.zh: 建中初，炎為宰相，薦既濟才堪史任，召拜左拾遺、史館修撰。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jianzhong reign Yan became chancellor and recommended that Ji Ji's talent was fit for historiographical duty; he was summoned and appointed Left Remonstrance and Reviser and Compiler in the Historiography Institute.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Jianzhong Yan became chancellor and recommended Ji Ji's talent for historiographical duty; he was summoned and appointed Left Remonstrance and Reviser and Compiler in the Historiography Institute.

sentences.zh: 既濟以吳兢撰《國史》，以則天事立本紀，奏議非之曰：

translations.literal: Because Wu Jing had compiled the National History and established a basic annal for Empress Wu Zetian's reign, Ji Ji submitted a memorial objecting:
translations.idiomatic: Because Wu Jing had compiled the National History and established a basic annal for Empress Wu Zetian's reign, Ji Ji submitted a memorial objecting:

sentences.zh: 史氏之作，本乎懲勸，以正君臣，以維家邦。

translations.literal: The historiographer's work is rooted in admonition and encouragement, to correct ruler and subject and to sustain family and state.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer's work is rooted in admonition and encouragement—to correct ruler and subject and to sustain family and state.

sentences.zh: 前端千古，後法萬代，使其生不敢差，死不妄懼。

translations.literal: It takes the front of a thousand ages and makes law for ten thousand generations, so that while living they dare not err and in death they dare not presume.
translations.idiomatic: It takes the front of a thousand ages and makes law for ten thousand generations, so that while living they dare not err and in death they dare not presume.

sentences.zh: 緯人倫而經世道，為百王準的；

translations.literal: It weaves human relations and threads the way of the world, serving as the standard for a hundred kings;
translations.idiomatic: It weaves human relations and threads the way of the world, serving as the standard for a hundred kings;

sentences.zh: 不止屬辭比事，以日系月而已。

translations.literal: it is not merely arranging words and comparing events, month following month.
translations.idiomatic: it is not merely arranging words and comparing events, month following month.

sentences.zh: 故善惡之道，在乎勸誡；

translations.literal: Thus the way of good and evil lies in admonition and warning;
translations.idiomatic: Thus the way of good and evil lies in admonition and warning;

sentences.zh: 勸誡之柄，存乎褒貶。

translations.literal: the handle of admonition and warning rests in praise and blame.
translations.idiomatic: the handle of admonition and warning rests in praise and blame.

sentences.zh: 是以《春秋》之義，尊卑輕重升降，幾微仿佛，雖一字二字，必有微旨存焉。

translations.literal: Therefore the meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals—in raising and lowering noble and humble, light and heavy, in the slightest shades—is that even in one or two characters a subtle intent must be preserved.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals—in raising and lowering noble and humble, light and heavy, in the slightest shades—is that even in one or two characters a subtle intent must be preserved.

sentences.zh: 況鴻名大統，其可以貸乎？

translations.literal: How much more when it is a great name and supreme succession—can that be lent out?
translations.idiomatic: How much more when it is a great name and supreme succession—can that be lent out?

sentences.zh: 伏以則天皇后，初以聰明睿哲，內輔時政，厥功茂矣。

translations.literal: I respectfully observe that Empress Wu Zetian, by her intelligence and sagacity at first, assisted in governing from within, and her achievements were abundant.
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully observe that Empress Wu Zetian, by her intelligence and sagacity at first, assisted in governing from within, and her achievements were abundant.

sentences.zh: 及弘道之際，孝和以長君嗣位，而太后以專制臨朝；

translations.literal: At the time of the Hongdao transition, Xiaozong as the elder sovereign succeeded to the throne, yet the empress dowager held sole rule over the court;
translations.idiomatic: At the time of the Hongdao transition, Xiaozong as the elder sovereign succeeded to the throne, yet the empress dowager held sole rule over the court;

sentences.zh: 俄又廢帝，或幽或徙。

translations.literal: soon she deposed the emperor, imprisoning or banishing him.
translations.idiomatic: soon she deposed the emperor, imprisoning or banishing him.

sentences.zh: 既而握圖稱箓，移運革名，牝司燕啄之蹤，難乎備述。

translations.literal: Then she grasped the chart and claimed the succession, shifted the mandate and changed the dynastic name; the traces of a hen ruling and a swallow usurping are hard to recount in full.
translations.idiomatic: Then she grasped the chart and claimed the succession, shifted the mandate and changed the dynastic name; the traces of a hen ruling and a swallow usurping are hard to recount in full.

sentences.zh: 其後五王建策，皇運復興，議名之際，得無降損。

translations.literal: Afterward the Five Princes devised policy and the imperial fortune was revived; at the moment of deciding the name, could there be no lowering or reduction?
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the Five Princes devised policy and the imperial fortune was revived; at the moment of deciding the name, could there be no lowering or reduction?

sentences.zh: 必將義以親隱，禮從國諱，茍不及損，當如其常，安可橫絕彜典，超居帝籍？

translations.literal: If righteousness requires concealing kin and ritual follows state taboo, if it cannot reach the point of injury it should remain as usual—how can one recklessly sever the constant canon and leap above the register of emperors?
translations.idiomatic: If righteousness requires concealing kin and ritual follows state taboo, if it cannot reach the point of injury it should remain as usual—how can one recklessly sever the constant canon and leap above the register of emperors?

sentences.zh: 昔仲尼有言，必也正名，故夏、殷二代為帝者三十世矣，而周人通名之曰王；

translations.literal: Confucius once said, "One must rectify names"; thus though Xia and Shang had thirty generations of rulers called emperors, the Zhou uniformly named them kings;
translations.idiomatic: Confucius once said, "One must rectify names"; thus though Xia and Shang had thirty generations of rulers called emperors, the Zhou uniformly named them kings;

sentences.zh: 吳、楚、越之君為王者百餘年，而《春秋》書之為子。

translations.literal: the rulers of Wu, Chu, and Yue were kings for more than a hundred years, yet the Spring and Autumn Annals records them as sons.
translations.idiomatic: the rulers of Wu, Chu, and Yue were kings for more than a hundred years, yet the Spring and Autumn Annals records them as sons.

sentences.zh: 蓋高下自乎彼，而是非稽乎我。

translations.literal: High and low depend on them, but right and wrong are judged by us.
translations.idiomatic: High and low depend on them, but right and wrong are judged by us.

sentences.zh: 過者抑之，不及者援之，不為弱減，不為僭奪。

translations.literal: Where there is excess, suppress it; where there is deficiency, support it—neither diminishing the weak nor seizing from the presumptuous.
